definition: Reduced number of observable peroxisomes per cell. This feature can be observed by immunohistochemical staining of cultured cells (such as fibroblasts) or by electronmicroscopy.

name: Reduced sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase activity
definition: Reduced activity of the enzyme sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase, which typically is measured in a biopsy specimen from liver or muscle.

name: Deficit at segmental level
definition: Refers to distribution of neurological deficits that corresponds to a deficit of a specific spinal segment and all segments below it.

name: Rhabdoid tumor
definition: Rhabdoid tumors are rare aggressive malignancies in infants and young children with a poor prognosis. The most common anatomic localizations are the central nervous system, the kidneys, and other soft tissues.

name: Rhabdoid tumor of the ovary
definition: A highly aggressive, extremely rare neoplasm of the ovary that is usually seen in children. The term rhabdoid is used because the tumor cells resemble rhabdomyoblasts but lack myogenic markers.

name: Cardiac rhabdoid tumor
definition: A rare and aggressive neoplasms developing mainly in the kidney but also in cerebral and extra-cerebral tissues and rarely in the heart. Histologically, rhabdoid renal and extrarenal tumors share common characteristics. The cells are polygonal, with eccentric, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, eosinophilic cytoplasmic inclusions. The tumors have an infiltrative growth pattern, necrosis, and high proliferative index. The immunohistochemistry tools of investigation facilitate differential diagnosis by showing loss of INI-1 expression, usually accompanied by germline mutations of the SMARCB1 gene. When INI-1 is still expressed in the affected tissues, a rhabdoid tumor with SMARCA4 mutations should be considered.

name: Malignant rhabdoid tumor of the bladder
definition: A rhabdoid tumor (a rare aggressive malignancies in infants and young children with a poor prognosis) originating in the urinary bladder.

name: Malignant rhabdoid tumor of liver
definition: A malginant rhabdoid tumor (MRT) originating in the liver. MRT are best characterized by the presence of round or polygonal cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, typical eosinophilic perinuclear inclusions, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli. Immunohistochemical expression of vimentin and epithelial markers and lack of staining for S-100, myoglobin and desmin are commonly found, but are non-specific.

name: Malignant rhabdoid tumor of muscle
definition: A malginant rhabdoid tumor (MRT) originating in muscle tissue.

name: Neck teratoma
definition: A teratoma located in the neck.

name: Kidney teratoma
definition: A teratoma located in a kidney.

name: Elevated urinary 5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxamide-riboside level
definition: Increased amount of 5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxamide(AICA)-riboside in the urine. AICA-riboside is the dephosphorylated counterpart of AICAR, an intermediate of de novo purine biosynthesis.

name: Aplasia of posterior communicating artery
definition: A developmental anomnaly characterized by the lack of development of the posterior communicating artery.

synonyms.text: Absence of both posterior communicating arteries

comments: The posterior communicating arteries connect the internal carotid artery just proximal to its bifurcation into the anterior cerebral artery and middle cerebral artery with the posterior cerebral artery. The posterior communicating artery is part of the circle of Willis.

name: Optic pit
definition: A developmental anomaly characterized by congenital excavation of the optic nerve head.

name: Ameliorated by naloxone
definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with naloxone, an opioid antagonist.

name: Ameliorated by pyridoxal phosphate
definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by ingestion of pyridoxal phosphate (activated vitamin B6).

name: Thickened intrahepatic portal venules
definition: Increased width of the vascular wall of portal venules within the liver.
comments: The portal vein (PV) is the main vessel of the portal venous system (PVS), which drains the blood from the gastrointestinal tract, gallbladder, pancreas, and spleen to the liver. Once in the liver, the PV ramifies and reaches the sinusoids, forming portal venules.

name: Ovarian fibrosis
definition: Excessive proliferation of fibroblasts and deposition of extracellular matrix within the ovary.

name: Pigment incontinence
definition: A process in which melanosomes (melanin granules) are deposited in the dermis. The dermal melanosomes are observed to be mainly in macrophages. This phenomenon of pigmentary incontinence usually follows an inflammatory process with the basic feature of basal cell damage, such as in lichen planus, lupus erythematosus, Riehl's melanosis, incontinentia pigmenti (Bloch-Sulzberger), and fixed drug eruption. Incontinence of pigment, or dropping off of epidermal melanin into the dermis, frequently produces a clinically recognizable and characteristic slate-gray pigmentation.

name: Reduced epidermal keratin 10 protein expression
definition: Amount of keratin 10 in the epidermis below the lower limit of normal. The findiong is typically ascertained by immunofluorescent microscopy.
comments: This feature can be assessed antibody staining of a skin biopsy specimen.

name: Reduced epidermal collagen IV protein expression

synonyms.text: Skin biopsy: collagen IV antibody staining abnormal or absent

comments: Lower than normal amount of collagen IV in the epidermis.

name: Reduced epidermal bullous pemphigoid antigen 1 protein expression
definition: Lower than normal amount of bullous pemphigoid antigen 1 (BP230) in the epidermis.

synonyms.text: Skin biopsy: BPAG1-e antibody staining abnormal or absent

name: Reduced epidermal collagen VII protein expression

synonyms.text: Skin biopsy: collagen VII antibody staining abnormal or absent

comments: Lower than normal amount of collagen VII in the epidermis.

name: Reduced epidermal collagen XVII protein expression

synonyms.text: Skin biopsy: collagen XVII antibody staining abnormal or absent

comments: Lower than normal amount of collagen XVII in the epidermis.

name: Reduced epidermal integrin alpha6beta4 protein expression

synonyms.text: Skin biopsy: integrin alpha6beta4 antibody staining abnormal or absent

comments: Lower than normal amount of integrin alpha6beta4 in the epidermis.

name: Reduced epidermal plectin protein expression

synonyms.text: Skin biopsy: plectin antibody staining abnormal or absent

comments: Lower than normal amount of plectin in the epidermis.

name: Bloodstream Trypanosoma cruzi
definition: Presence of Trypanosoma cruzi in the blood stream. Trypanosoma cruzii is the etiological agent of Chagas disease.

synonyms.text: Trypanosoma cruzi present on peripheral blood smear

name: Abnormal lymph node cell composition
definition: A deviation from the normal distribution of cell types or their relative proportions in a lymph node.

name: Lipid-laden lymph node macrophages
definition: Lymph node with increased numbers of macrophages heavily laden with lipids.

name: Abnormal pancreatic acinus morphology
definition: Structural anomal of pancreatic acinus.
comments: The exocrine pancreas is structurally analogous to a bunch of grapes; this architecture contains microscopic, blind-ended tubules that are surrounded by polygonal acinar cells and these tubules are organized into lobules called acini. The primary function of the acini is to synthesize and secrete hydrolytic enzymes which empty into the duodenum for the digestion of our daily foodstuff. Each acinus consists of a small cluster of secretory epithelial cells that form a small central lumen, called intercellular canaliculi. Each acinar cell has a round pyramid-like shape.

name: Cochlear nerve hypoplasia
definition: A developmental defect characterized by underdevelopment of the cochlear nerve.

name: Glutathionuria
definition: Level of glutathione in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

name: Nevus psiloliparus
definition: Nevus psiloliparus is a rare fatty tissue nevus that is a marker for encephalocraniocutaneous lipomatosis, a neurocutaneous syndrome with ocular and central nervous system anomalies. Clinically, nevus psiloliparus is often described as a congenital alopecia and appears as an irregularly shaped, circumscribed area of alopecia on the scalp. Histopathology demonstrates a near-complete absence of mature hair follicles with preservation of arrector pili muscles and mature adipocytes within the dermis.

name: Crypt hyperplasia
definition: Crypt hyperplasia denotes elongation of the length of the crypts of Lieberkuhn, a process that initially precedes villous atrophy. Elongation may be caused by expansion of the lamina propria as a result of the proliferation of stromal cells, an influx of inflammatory cells and tissue remodeling.

name: Increased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate concentration
definition: Concentration of dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
comments: Dehydroepiandrosterone (DHEA) is produced in the adrenal glands and to a lesser extent by the ovaries and testes. DHEA is metabolized into DHEA-S in the adrenal glands and liver. Dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate is a precursor of testosterone and estrogen.

name: Abnormal circulating thyroxine-binding globulin concentration
definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of thyroxine-binding globulin in the blood circulation.

name: Decreased circulating thyroxine-binding globulin concentration
definition: The concentration of thyroxine-binding globulin in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

synonyms.text: Decreased thyroxine-binding globulin level in blood
Reduced thyroxine-binding globulin level in blood

comments: Thyroxin-binding globulin (TBG) is known as serpin peptidase inhibitor, clade A (alpha-1 antiproteinase, antitrypsin), member 7 (SERPINA7), Entrez Gene ID 6906. Individuals with TBG deficiency are euthyroid. TBG is responsible for carrying the thyroid hormones thyroxine (T4) and 3,5,3'-triiodothyronine (T3) in the bloodstream.

name: Elevated circulating beta-aminoisobutyric acid concentration
definition: An increased concentration of beta-aminoisobutyric acid in the blood circulation.

name: Elevated circulating dihydrouracil concentration
definition: An increased concentration of dihydrouracil in the blood circulation. Dihydrouracil is an intermediate in the catabolism of uracil that is also known as 5,6-dihydrouracil.

name: Elevated circulating dihydrothymine concentration
definition: An increased concentration of dihydrothymine in the blood circulation. Dihydrouracil is an intermediate in the catabolism of thymine.

name: Elevated circulating N-carbamoyl-beta-alanine concentration
definition: An increased concentrationof N-carbamoyl-beta-alanine in the blood circulation.
comments: Elevated 3-ureidopropionic acid

name: Elevated ciculating 5-hydroxymethyluracil concentration
definition: An increased concentration of 5-hydroxymethyluracil in the blood circulation.

name: Decreased CSF creatinine concentration
definition: Concentration of creatinine in the cerebrrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

name: Elevated urinary creatine level
definition: An increased amount of creatine in the urine.

name: Decreased circulating biotin concentration
definition: Concentration of biotin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: Elevated circulating thrombopoietin concentration
definition: Concentration of thrombopoietin in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Thrombopoietin is a glycoprotein hormone produced by the liver and kidney that stimulates the production and differentiation of megakaryocytes.

name: Decreased circulating C1q concentration
definition: Concentration or activity of the C1q protein in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. C1q is the first component of the classical pathway and is composed of the C1qA chain, C1qB chain, and C1qC chain, which are encoded by C1qA, C1qB, and C1qC genes.

name: Decreased circulating apolipoprotein A-II concentration
definition: The concentration of apolipoprotein A-II in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

synonyms.text: Decreased apolipoprotein A-II level in blood
Reduced apolipoprotein A-II level in blood

name: Elevated circulating DOPA concentration
definition: Concentration of DOPA (3,4-dihydroxyphenylalanine) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated CSF DOPA concentration
definition: Concentration of DOPA (3,4-dihydroxyphenylalanine) in the cerebrospinal fluid above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated circulating porphyrin concentration
definition: The concentration of porphyrins in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
comments: Most commonly tested circulating porphyrins are coproporphyrin, protoporphyrin, and uroporphyrin. Normally protoporphyrin is present in the highest concentration.

name: Decreased circulating 17-hydroxyprogesterone concentration
definition: Concentration of 17-hydroxyprogesterone in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: Decreased circulating transcobalamin-2 concentration
definition: The concentration of transcobalamin-2 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Polychromasia
definition: Increased variation in the color of the erythrocytes (red blood cells), including pale red, normal or dark colors, indicating a highly variable hemoglobin concentration. Typically this indicates the release of immature erythrocytes in states of anemia.

name: Decreased circulating myo-inositol concentration
definition: Concentration of myo-inositol in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: Elevated circulating arabinitol concentration
definition: Concentration of arabinitol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine arabitol level
definition: Amount of arabitol in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine erythritol level
definition: Amount of erythritol in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated circulating erythritol concentration
definition: Concentration of erythritol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Decreased circulating matrix metalloproteinase 2 concentration
definition: The concentration of matrix metalloproteinase 2 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

synonyms.text: Decreased 72 kDa type IV collagenase concentration
Decreased 72 kDa type IV collagenase level
Decreased 72 kDa type IV collagenase level in blood
Reduced 72 kDa type IV collagenase concentration
Reduced 72 kDa type IV collagenase level
Reduced 72 kDa type IV collagenase level in blood

name: Abnormal circulating coenzyme concentration
definition: Concentration of a coenzyme (an organic molecule that binds to the active sites of an enzyme to promote the catalysis of a reaction) is above or below the limits of normal.

name: Elevated circulating S-adenosyl methionine concentration
definition: Concentration of S-adenosyl methionine (SAM) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. SAM is a cosubstrate involved in methyl group transfers, transsulfuration, and aminopropylation.

name: Abnormal circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of membrane cofactor protein in the blood circulation.

synonyms.text: Abnormal circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration

comments: Membrane cofactor protein (MCP, CD46) is a cell surface complement regulatory protein which acts as a cofactor for the factor I-mediated cleavage of the activated complement components C3b/C4b.

name: Decreased circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
definition: The concentration of membrane cofactor protein in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

synonyms.text: Decreased circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
Decreased membrane cofactor protein level in blood
MCP (membrane cofactor protein) low in blood
Reduced membrane cofactor protein level in blood

name: Elevated circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
definition: The concentration of membrane cofactor protein in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

synonyms.text: Elevated circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
Elevated membrane cofactor protein level in blood
Increased membrane cofactor protein level in blood

name: Hepatic xanthomatosis
definition: Lipid deposits localized within the liver. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

name: Adrenal xanthomatosis
definition: Lipid deposits localized within the adrenal gland. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

name: Splenic xanthomatosis
definition: Lipid deposits localized within the spleen. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

name: Spinal cord xanthomatosis
definition: Lipid deposits localized within the spinal cord. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

name: Brain xanthomatosis
definition: Lipid deposits localized within the brain. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

name: Pulmonary xanthomatosis
definition: Lipid deposits localized within the lung. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

name: Bone marrow xanthomatosis
definition: Lipid deposits localized within the bone marrow. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

name: Lymph node xanthomatosis
definition: Lipid deposits localized within one or more lymph nodes. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

name: Xanthoma of bone
definition: Xanthoma of bone is an exceedingly rare benign primary bone tumor histologically characterized by mononuclear macrophage-like cells, abundant foam cells, and multinucleated giant cells.
comments: Because of the aggressive radiographic appearance of bone xanthoma, other primary bone tumors and metastatic lesions need to be ruled out.

name: Ameliorated by folinic acid
definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with folinic acid.

name: Triggered by succinylcholine anesthetic
definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a succinylcholine anesthetic such as suxamethonium.

name: Exogenous androgen exposure
definition: History of having been treated with an exogenous androgen medication.

name: Reduced muscle enolase activity
definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme enolase in muscle tissue. The enzyme enolase catalyzes the interconversion of 2-phosphoglycerate and phosphoenolpyruvate. In adult human muscle, over 90% of enolase activity is accounted for by the beta-enolase subunit, the protein product of the ENO3 gene.

name: Dopamine antagonist exposure
definition: History of having been treated with a dopamine antagonist including metaclopramide, phenothiazine; haloperidol, chlorpromazine, promethazine, prochlorperazine, ziprasidone, and quetiapine.

name: Muscle fiber granulofilamentous inclusion bodies
definition: The presence of inclusion bodies within the cytoplasm of muscle cells that contain a mxiture of granules and filaments.
comments: See Figure 7B of PMID:19181099.

name: Bone marrow myeloid vacuolization
definition: Formation of vacuoles (a space within a cell that is empty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in the cytoplasm of myeloid precursors in the bone marrow.

synonyms.text: Vacuolization of bone marrow myeloid precursors

comments: See Figure 1 of PMID:33690844.

name: Pulmonary cylindroma
definition: A cylindroma located in the lung. Cylindromas are well-circumscribed, smooth, pale pink nodular tumors, often with arborizing vessels visible. The tumors are slow growing and vary in size from a few millimeters to over 5 mm.
comments: See Figure 1 of PMID:29569226.

name: Colonic fibrinopurulent exudate
definition: Fluid visible on the colonic surface containing fibrin, inflammatory cells, and cellular debris.

name: Bloodstream microfilaria
definition: Presence of filaria in the blood stream. Filariasis is a common cause of elephantiasis in Coastal Districts of India. The initial manifestations are repeated episodes of fever with chills and rigor, lymphadenopathy which gradually progress to elephantiasis. In India filarial infestation is commonly caused by W. bancrofti and Brugia malayi, the former responsible for almost 98 percent of all cases.
comments: Filariasis is an infectious parasitic disease caused by roundworms that belong to the family Filarioidea. These are spread by bloodfeeding insects such as black flies and mosquitoes. Eight known filarial nematodes use humans as their definitive hosts. See Figure 1 of PMID:32313484.

name: Skin infectious agent
definition: The presence of an infectious agent in the skin.

name: Dermal microfilaria
definition: Presence of filariae in the skin.

name: Dermal papillary IgA deposition
definition: Accumulation of immunoglobulin A (IgA) surrounding dermal papillae, which are specialized cells that support the hair follicle.

synonyms.text: Granular IgA deposits at the dermal papillae

name: Dermal immune complex deposition
definition: Accumulation of antigen-bound antibody in the skin.

name: Abnormal liver metabolite concentration
definition: The concentration of a metabolite in the liver is above or below the limits of normal.

name: Hepatic polyglucosan accumulation
definition: Intracellular accumulation of polyglucosan bodies-containing amylopectinlike polysaccharide-in the liver.

synonyms.text: Accumulation of polyglucosan bodies in the liver

name: Urinary bladder neurofibroma
definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) located in the urinary bladder.

name: Synovial granuloma
definition: An aggregation of macrophages (forming in response to chronic inflammation) localized in the lining of a joint (synovium).

name: Elevated urine fumaric acid level
definition: The concentration of fumaric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine N-acetylaspartic acid level
definition: The amount of N-acetylaspartate in the urine, when corrected for urine concentration, is above upper limit of normal. This feature can be measured using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry.
comments: Although NAA concentration is also elevated in the blood and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) of children with neonatal/infantile (severe) Canavan disease, elevated concentration of NAA in urine is sufficient for diagnosis of affected individuals.

name: Elevated urine suberylglycine level
definition: Level of suberylglycine in urine above upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine phenylpropionylglycine level
definition: Level of phenylpropionylglycine in urine above upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine octenedioic acid level
definition: The concentration of octenedioic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Monocarboxylic aciduria
definition: Level of a monocarboxylic acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal. A monocarboxylic acid is an oxoacid containing one carboxy group.

name: Elevated urine octanoic acid level
definition: Amount of octanoic acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine glutaconic acid level
definition: The concentration of glutaconic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine 3-hydroxyglutaric level
definition: The concentration of 3-hydroxyglutaric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine malonic acid level
definition: The concentration of malonic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine propionylglycine level
definition: Amount of propionylglycine in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine tiglylglycine level
definition: Amount of tiglylglycine in the urine above upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine 2-methylacetoacetic acid level
definition: Amount of 2-methylacetoacetic acid in the urine above upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine 3-hydroxypropionic acid level
definition: Amount of 3-hydroxypropionic acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine 2-methylcitric acid level
definition: Amount of 2-methylcitric acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine 4-hydroxyisovaleric acid level
definition: Amount of 4-hydroxyisovaleric acid in urine above upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine 2-hydroxy-3-methylvaleric acid level
definition: Amount of 2-hydroxy-3-methylvaleric acid in the urine above the upper limit of normal. 2-Hydroxy-3-methylpentanoic acid or 2-hydroxy-3-methylvaleric acid (HMVA) is an organic acid generated by L-isoleucine metabolism.
comments: 2-hydroxy-3-methylvaleric acid is elevated in individuals with mapel syrup urine disease.

name: Shoulder contracture
definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of the shoulder joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.

name: Shoulder extension contracture
definition: Lack of the full expected passive range of flexion of the shoulder joint (Shoulder flexion puts the arms from a resting position at one's sides to straight above the head; thus, with shoulder extension contracture it is not possible to raise the arms above the head fully).

name: Thumb extension contracture
definition: Movement in the sagittal plane that increases the angle of the thumb joint (straightens the joint); motion involving posterior bending of the vertebral column or returning to the upright position from a flexed position.

name: Tongue myxoma
definition: A myxoma (benign soft tissue neoplasm characterized by the presence of spindle and stellate cells, lobulated growth pattern, and myxoid stroma formation) localized in the tongue.

name: Abnormal knee morphology
definition: A structural abnormality of the knee joint or surrounding structures.

name: Abnormal knee physiology
definition: A functional anomaly of the knee joint.

name: Knee contracture
definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of the knee joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.

name: Knee extension contracture
definition: A type of knee joint contracture in which the knee lacks full expected flexion, such that the upper and lower leg cannot be brought together.

name: Abnormal ankle morphology
definition: A structural anomaly of the ankle.

name: Abnormal ankle physiology
definition: A functional anomaly of the ankle.

name: Toe joint contracture
definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of a toe joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.

name: Extension contracture of toe
definition: A type of toe joint contracture in which the joint lacks full expected flexion, so that the two bony segments on either side of their connecting joint cannot be brought together.

name: Finger joint contracture
definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of a finger joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.

name: Extension contracture of finger
definition: A type of finger joint contracture in which the joint lacks full expected flexion, so that the two bony segments on either side of their connecting joint cannot be brought together.

name: Reduced muscle telethonin level
definition: Amount of telethonin protein expression in muscle tissue below lower limit of normal. Telethonin is a 19-kDa sarcomeric protein, localized to the Z-disc of skeletal and cardiac muscles.

synonyms.text: Muscle biopsy: telethonin low or absent

name: Abnormal enzyme concentration or activity
definition: Concentration or activity of an enzyme is above or below the limits of normal.

name: Abnormal liver enzyme activity or concentration
definition: Concentration or activity of an enzyme is above or below the limits of normal in liver tissue.

synonyms.text: Abnormal hepatic enzyme activity or concentration

name: Reduced hepatic urocanase activity
definition: Activity of urocanase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

name: Impaired cerebroside sulfate hydrolysis
definition: Reduced hydrolysis (splitting of a bond and the addition of the hydrogen anion of water) of the sulfuric ester linkage in the molecule of cerebroside sulfate, possibly leading to accumuation of cerebroside sulfate.
comments: This feature can be assayed by cerebroside sulfate loading tests of cultured dermal fibroblasts.

name: Reduced peroxisomal glutaryl-CoA oxidase activity
definition: Diminished enzyme activity of peroxisomal glutaryl-CoA oxidase, an enzyme that metabolizes glutaryl-CoA (a metabolite of L-lysine, L-hydroxy-lysine and L-tryptophan) by dehydrogenation to glutaconyl-CoA directly followed by decarboxylation of this to crotonyl-CoA.

name: Reduced sterol 27-hydroxylase activity
definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme sterol 27-hydroxylase, which participates in the degradation of cholesterol to bile acid. Sterol 27-hydroxylase catalyzes the first step in the normal oxidation of the steroid side chain, converting cholesterol, as well as different 7a-hydroxylated cholesterol metabolites, to 27-oxygenated steroids.

name: Reduced short-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme Short-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (SCAD), a key enzyme of fatty acid beta-oxidation that catalyzes the first step in mitochondrial beta-oxidation of fatty acids.

name: Reduced 3-phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme 3-phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase (PGDH), which catalyzes the first step in the pathway by converting D-3-phosphoglycerate (PGA), an intermediate in glycolysis, to phosphohydroxypyruvate concomitant with the reduction of NAD+.

name: Elongated mitochondria
definition: Increase in length of mitochondria.
comments: Mitochondrial elongation can be initiated by a gradual merge of the outer mitochondrial membranes of two individual mitochondria.

name: Reduced hepatic methionine adenosyltransferase activity
definition: Activity of methionine adenosyltransferase in the liver below the lower limit of normal. Note that there are multiple methionine adenosyltransferase isoezymes.

name: Substantia nigra dopaminergic neuron loss
definition: Degeneration and loss of neurons in the substantia nigra of the brain.
comments: Ppigmented neurons in the substantia nigra produce the neurotransmitter dopamine. The loss of these neurons leads to the classical motor symptoms of Parkinson disease. The pigment contained within these neurons, termed neuromelanin because of its similar appearance to cutaneous melanin, is so abundant in the substantia nigra of the human brain that this structure can be seen macroscopically as a darkened area (hence the origin of the name given to this brain region)

name: Intramuscular lipoma
definition: A lipoma that is located within a muscle.

name: Cutaneous telangiectasia
definition: Dilated blood vessels on the skin.

name: Abnormal aromatase activity
definition: Aromatase activity outside of the normal range.
comments: Aromatase is a specific component of the cytochrome P450 enzyme system responsible for the transformation of androgen precursors into estrogens. This enzyme is encoded by the CYP19A1 gene located at chromosome 15q21.2, that is, expressed in ovary and testis, but also in many extraglandular sites such as the placenta, brain, adipose tissue, and bone. {xref="PMID:21772971"}

name: Elevated aromatase activity
definition: Enzyme activity of aromatase above the upper limit of normal.

name: Reduced aromatase activity
definition: Enzyme activity of aromatase below the lower limit of normal.

name: Corneal amyloidosis
definition: A form of amyloidosis that is located in the cornea.

name: Abnormal keratinocyte morphology
definition: Any structural anomaly of the keratinocyte. The keratinocyte is the major cell type of the epidermis and is responsible for generating the protective barrier.

name: Keratinocyte vacuolization
definition: Increased number of vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles that areempty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in keratinocytes.

name: Parotid gland adenocarcinoma
definition: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the parotid gland.

name: Pulmonary vasculitis
definition: Cellular inflammation, vessel destruction, and tissue necrosis of the blood vessels of the lung.

name: Reduced hepatic D-glycerate kinase activity
definition: Activity of D-glycerate kinase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

name: Lymph-node hemophagocytosis
definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages in a lymph node.
comments: See Figure 1 of PMID:16859547.

name: Superior pubic ramus hypoplasia
definition: Underdevelopment of the upper branch of the pubis bone (inferior pubic ramus).

name: Uterine adenofibroma
definition: A rare benign mullerian mixed tumor of the uterus composed of benign epithelial and mesenchymal components.

name: Pulmonary hamartoma
definition: A benign malformation of the lung that includes an abnormal mixture of tissue components such as cartilage, epithelium, fat, or muscle which are common to the lung but without preservation of the organ architecture.

name: Peripheral axonal distension
definition: An abnormal histological finding characterized by an increase in the cross-section area of peripheral nerve axons (up to 20-25 micrometers in diameter).
comments: In giant axonal neuropathy, distended axons are observed in conjunction with thin myelin sheaths. Distended axons may be filled with masses of neurofilaments. See Figures 4 and 5 of PMID:15897506.

name: Decreased circulating alpha-mannosidase activity
definition: Concentration or activity of alpha mannosidase below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.

name: Abnormal hepatocyte morphology
definition: A structural anomaly of the hepatocyte, which is the main cell type that makes up the liver perncyhma. Hepatocytes are usually binucleated and appear as sheets in the liver tissue.

name: Hepatic melanin-like lysosomal pigmentation
definition: Accumulation of dark, coarsely granular pigment localized in lysosomes of centrilobular hepatocytes.

name: Reduced uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase activity
definition: Activity of the enzyme uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase (UROD; EC 4.1.1.37) below the lower limit of normal.
comments: Uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase low

name: Reduced heme oxygenase activity
definition: Activity of the enzyme heme oxygenase below the lower limit of normal.

name: Swollen achromatic neurons in the cerebral cortex
definition: The presence of enlarged and swollen neurons that lack Nissl bodies (the rough endoplasmic reticulum-achromasia refers to neurons that lack Nissl bodies) in the cortex of the brain.

name: Vacuolated hepatocytes
definition: Presence of vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles that areempty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in hepatocytes, which normally rarely contain vacuoles.

name: Lack of oocyte pronucleus formation
definition: An abnormality of oocyte maturation characterized by the inability of oocytes to form pronuclei after in vitro fertilization procedures. Oocytes normally show two pronuclei 17 to 20 hours after in vitro insemination.

name: Self-healing squamous epithelioma
definition: A type of skin tumor that initially presents as a reddish macule and subsequently becomes papular, enlarged, ulcerated and ultimately heals leaving pitted scars.
comments: Individuals with pathogenic variants in TGFBR1 may present with multiple self-healing squamous epitheliomas. See Figure 1 of PMID:33256177.

name: Elevated circulating pristanic acid concentration
definition: Concentration of pristanic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Sarcoplasmic bodies
definition: Rounded or oval structures that appeared brown on hematoxylin and eosin and red on the modified Gomori trichrome stain.
comments: The sarcoplasm is the cytoplasm of a muscle cell.

name: Elevated CSF hydroxyproline concentration
comments: Concentration of hydroxyproline in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

name: Reduced CSF cystine concentration
definition: Concentration of cystine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal. Cystine is sulfur-containing amino acid obtained by the oxidation of two cysteine molecules which are then linked via a disulfide bond.

name: Abnormal circulating beta-mannosidase activity
definition: Activity of the enzyme beta-mannosidase outside normal limits. Beta-mannosidase is a lysosomal enzyme that catabolizes oligosaccharides.

name: Elevated circulating beta-mannosidase activity
definition: Activity of the enzyme beta-mannosidase above the upper limit of normal. Beta-mannosidase is a lysosomal enzyme that catabolizes oligosaccharides.

name: Reduced circulating alpha-L-fucosidase activity
definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase below the lower limit of normal.

name: Abnormal circulating alpha-L-fucosidase activity
definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase in the blood circulation outside the limits of normal.

name: Elevated circulating alpha-L-fucosidase activity
definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated circulating S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine concentration
definition: Increased concentration of S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine in the blood circulation.

name: Elevated circulating S-adenosyl-L-methionine concentration
definition: Concentration S-adenosyl-L-methionine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Exercise-triggered malignant hyperthermia
definition: Malignant hyperthermia that is characterized by exercise-induced life-threatening hyperthermia with a body temperature over 40 degrees C and signs of encephalopathy ranging from confusion to convulsions or coma. Incidence increases with rising ambient temperature and relative humidity. Manifestations may include rhabdomyolysis (presenting with myalgia, muscle weakness, and myoglobinuria), tachycardia, and in severe cases multiorgan failure.

name: Anesthesic-triggered malignant hyperthermia
definition: Malignant hyperthermia that is characterized by a rapid increase in temperature to 39-42 degrees C in response to inhalational anesthetics such as halothane or to muscle relaxants such as succinylcholine.

name: Elevated CSF argininosuccinic acid concentration
definition: Concentration of argininosuccinic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated CSF aspartylglucosamine concentration
definition: Concentration of aspartylglucosamine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.
comments: Aspartylglucosamine is a derivative of aspartic acid.

name: Elevated circulating alpha-oxoadipic acid concentration
definition: Concentration of alpha-oxoadipic acid in the blood above the upper limit of normal.

name: Abnormal erythrocyte metabolite concentration
definition: A deviation from the normal range of a metabolite in red blood cells.

name: Reduced erythrocyte glutathione concentration
definition: Concentration of glutathione in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal. Glutathione (GSH) is an important redox active biomolecule critical in the maintenance and regulation of cellular and organismal health.

name: Elevated CSF sarcosine concentration
definition: Concentration of sarcosine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

name: Reduced CSF methionine concentration
definition: Concentration of methionine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

name: Elevated circulating homoarginine concentration
definition: Concentration of homoarginine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urinary formiminoglutamic acid level
definition: The concentration of formiminoglutamic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated CSF proline concentration
definition: Concentration of proline in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urinary S-sulfocysteine level
definition: Level of S-sulfocysteine high in urine above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated circulating S-sulfocysteine concentration
definition: Concentration of S-sulfocysteine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Sertoli cell hyperplasia
definition: Abnormal increase in the number of Sertoli cells in the testis.
comments: Sertoli cells are present in the seminiferous tubules of the testes, comprising one of the two types of cells in the germinal epithelium, the other being of spermatogonia lineage. Sertoli cells are one of the most important cells necessary for sperm production in males. They are often identifiable as big, tightly linked cells near the basolateral portion of the seminiferous tubule.

name: CSF infectious agent
definition: The presence of an infectious agent in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

name: CSF mycobacteria
definition: Mycobacterium present in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). This feature can be ascertained by CSF microscopy.

name: Fungemia
definition: Detection of a fungal organism (such as candida or coccidioides) in the blood stream.

synonyms.text: Presence of fungi in the blood

name: Supraclavicular lymphadenopathy
definition: Enlarged lymph node located just above the clavicle (collarbone).

name: Inguinal lymphadenopathy
definition: Enlarged lymph node located in the inguinal region (groin).

name: Axillary lymphadenopathy
definition: Enlarged lymph node located in the axillary region (armpit).

name: Positive Murphy sign
definition: Murphy's sign is elicited in patients with acute cholecystitis by asking the patient to take in and hold a deep breath while palpating the subcostal region. In practice, Murphy's sign is performed by palpating the subcostal region during inspiration. If pain is elicited and the patient suddenly stops their inspiratory effort, a positive Murphy's sign has been elicited.

name: Bilious emesis
definition: Vomiting whereby the vomit has the color of bile, yellowish-green.

name: Ameliorated by NSAID
definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID).

name: Fetal exposure history
definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to a medication or other substance.

name: Fetal barbiturate exposure
definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to barbiturate medications such as phenobarbital. Barbiturates are used medically as anxiolytics, hypnotics, and anticonvulsants.

name: Fetal narcotic exposure
definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to narcotic medications such as morphine or codeine. Narcotics are used medically to treat moderate or severe pain.

name: Ameliorated by ethosuximide
definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by administration of ethosuximide. Ethosuximide is most often used to treat absence seizures.

name: Reduced epidermal extracellular matrix protein 1 protein expression
definition: Lower than normal amount of extracellular matrix protein 1 (ECM1) in the epidermis.

name: Neurofibroma by anatomical location
definition: Neurofibroma categorized according to the anatomical site of origin.

name: Tongue neurofibroma
definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the tongue.

name: Cardiac neurofibroma
definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the heart.

name: Gastric neurofibroma
definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the stomach.

name: Renal neurofibroma
definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the kidney.

name: Muscle fiber polyglucosan inclusion bodies
definition: Accumulation of a poorly branched and poorly spherical amylopectin-like glycogen (polyglucosan) in muscle fibers.

name: Abnormal rete ridge morphology
definition: Abnormal structure of the rete ridges (also known as rete pegs), which are downward projections of epithelium surrounding the connective tissue papillae in between the dermal papillae.

name: Rete ridge elongation
definition: Increased length of the rete rdiges of the epidermis.

name: Pulmonary Langerhans cell histiocytosis
definition: Accumulation of monoclonal CD1a-positive Langerhans cells in the bronchioles and alveolar interstitium that can cause damage to the lungs.

name: Lumbar hypolordosis
definition: Flattening of a curve in the spine in the lumbar (lower back) region.

name: Battle sign
definition: Battle sign is bruising over the mastoid process that is typically the result of head trauma. It is retroauricular or mastoid ecchymosis that is typically the result of head trauma. Battle sign typically requires significant head trauma and may indicate significant internal injury to the brain and not just the posterior cranial vault or mastoid.

name: Decreased skull base length
definition: Reduced anterioposterior dimension of the skull base.

name: Oscillopsia
definition: A visual disturbance in which objects in the visual field appear to oscillate (jump, jiggle, vibrate).
comments: Oscillopsia most often results from abnormal eye movements or from impaired vestibulo-ocular reflex.

name: Decreased blink rate
definition: The frequency with which the eye is blinked is below the lower limit of normal.
comments: A reduced blink rate may be observed in Parkinson's disease.

name: Abnormal blink rate
definition: A deviation from the normal frequency of blinking the eye.

name: Elevated blink rate
definition: The frequecy with which the eye is blinked is above the upper limit of normal.
comments: An increased blink rate in can be observed in schizophrenia, tardive dyskinesia, Tourette's syndrome and Meige's disease.

name: Purulent sputum
definition: Sputum contains pus.

name: Maternal hyperthyroidism
definition: The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of hyperthyroidism during the corresponding pregnancy.

name: Perineal
definition: Applies to an abnormality that affects the perineum (the region of skin between the genitals and the anus).

name: Gadolinium exposure
definition: History of exposure to gadolinium, a contrast medium often used for magnetic resonance imaging.

name: Purulent parotid gland drainage
definition: Excretion of pus (purulent discharge) from the opening of the parotid duct.
comments: See Figure 2 of PMID:34952006. The Stensen duct is also known as the parotid duct and is the route that saliva takes from the major salivary gland (parotid gland) to the mouth.

name: Obstipation
definition: Obstipation is the inability to pass either stool or flatus (gas).
comments: Obstipation can be a sign of an acute obstruction of the GI tract, either of the small or large bowel.

name: Posttussive emesis
definition: Vomiting following a coughing spell.
comments: Individuals with gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) will frequently vomit when coughing for a non-GI reason. Vomiting occurs during these coughing spells because the intrabdominal pressure is high from the coughing and the propensity to reflux results in stomach contents emerging as vomit. This is a historical question that allows a parent to impart information suggesting GERD at an age when it is difficult to obtain a reliable GERD history from the child.

name: Vasculitis by anatomical site
definition: Vasculitis categorized according to the anatomical site where the finding is localized.

name: Vasculitis by histology
definition: Vasculitis categorized according to type of histological abnormality.

name: Leukocytoclastic vasculitis
definition: A type of vasculitis characterized by the presence of debris of neutrophils within the blood vessel walls.

name: Accumulation of lipid droplets in small-bowel enterocytes
comments: The finding can be observed by strong brown cytoplasmic peroxidase staining of enterozytes in a biopsy specimen. See Figure 2 of PMID: 2426307.

name: Pericardial friction rub
definition: A pericardial friction rub is a grating, to-and-fro sound that occurs in phase with the heart sounds.
comments: Pericardial friction rubs can be differentiated from pleural friction rubs because they occur independently of breathing. A pericardial rub is highly specific for acute pericarditis. It is generally heard over the left sternal border, it is often louder at inspiration but sometimes can be better heard on forced expiration while the patient bends forward. In most cases, the rub is triphasic (audible in atrial, ventricular systole, and ventricular diastole phases) and is of high frequency.

name: Abnormal muscle succinate dehydrogenase staining
definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of staining of succinate dehydrogenase in skeletal muscle tissue.
comments: Succinate dehydrogenase (SDH) is a mitochondrial enzyme complex located in the inner mitochondrial membrane that has dual roles in the oxidation of succinate to fumarate in the Krebs cycle and in electron transport during oxidative phosphorylation.

name: Increased muscle succinate dehydrogenase staining
comments: Staining of succinate dehydrogenase in skeletal muscle tissue above the upper limit of normal.

name: Decreased muscle succinate dehydrogenase staining
comments: Staining of succinate dehydrogenase in skeletal muscle tissue below the lower limit of normal.

name: Small intestinal hamartoma
definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the small intestine.

name: Pyriform sperm head
definition: Pyriform spermatozoa consist of a normally shaped acrosomal structure which can be normal in size or enlarged, while the post-acrosomal region shows severe elongation and an acute narrowing to the posterior end, ending in about the same thickness as the connecting mid-piece.

name: Excess residual spermatozoal cytoplasm
definition: Excess residual cytoplasm is associated with abnormal spermatozoa produced from a defective spermiation process. This abnormal excess cytoplasm should not be confused with more physiological cytoplasmic residues that can be observed in direct microscopy of the ejaculate but not in dried, fixed and stained morphology smears.

name: Cardiomyocyte hyaline bodies
definition: Subsarcolemmal, eosinophilic glass-like regions within the cytoplasm of cardiomyocytes.

name: Hepatic hemophagocytosis
definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the liver.

name: CSF hemophagocytosis
definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

name: Splenic hemophagocytosis
definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the spleen.

name: Urinary bladder granulomatosis
definition: The presence of multiple granulomas in the urinary bladder as based on pathological examination. Granulomas are small 0.5 to 2 mm collections of modified macrophages called epithelioid cells usually surrounded by lymphocytes.

name: Epidermal necrosis
definition: Death of keratinocytes in the epidermis layer of the skin, which generally manifests as extensive exfoliation (separation of the epidermis from the underlying dermis).

name: Exacerbated by flexion
definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is aggravated by (or made more painful by) bending of a limb or joint.

name: Hemolacria
definition: The presence of blood in tears.

name: Corneal foreign body sensation
definition: A perception that an object is in contact with the eye.

synonyms.text: Foreign body sensation in the eye

name: Buttock pain
definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the buttock (round fleshy area at the lower rear area of a human trunk).

name: Vaginal foreign body sensation
definition: A perception that an object located in the vagina.

name: Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea
definition: Attacks of breathlessness that occur at night and may awaken the sleeping patient.

name: Eyelid pain
definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the eyelid.

name: Abnormal sperm physiology
definition: Abnormality of a sperm function including protection of paternal DNA, traversing the female reproductive tract, oocyte localisation, penetration of the zona pellucida, oocyte activation and centriole deposition.

name: Small acrosomal area
definition: Reduction in size of the acrosome below the lower limit of normal. The acrosome is a unique membranous organelle located over the anterior part of the sperm nucleus. According to the World Health Organization criteria, the acrosome must be clearly visible, comprising approximately 40-70 percent of the sperm head.

name: Bent sperm flagella
definition: The proportion of sperm cells whose flagella is sharply curved or has a sharp angle is above normal limits.

name: Spermiation failure
definition: Spermiation failure is indicated by apparently normal spermiogenesis, but the presence of retained Sd2 spermatids in stages III-V of human spermatogenesis, whereas maturation arrest is indicated by a lack of late Sd1 and Sd2 spermatids in the epithelium.
comments: It is important to note that multiple spermatogenic abnormalities often occur simultaneously in infertile men, and the helical nature of human spermatogenesis can make it difficult to readily discriminate multiple abnormalities of spermatid development and release.

name: Hypospermatogenesis
definition: A morphological abnormality visible upon biopsy of the germinal epithelium of the testis in which the cellularity of the germinal epithelium is reduced in general, so that all stages of germ cells (spermatogonia, spermatocytes, and spermatids) are present but reduced in number. This term applies to biopsies with some tubules showing diminished amounts of qualitatively complete spermatogenesis in combination with a vast majority of tubules that lack germ cells.

name: Conjunctival membrane
definition: Formation of a sheet of tissue by coagulum of exudate over the conjunctiva of the eye that if removed leaves behind a denuded bleeding surface.

name: Extreme oligozoospermia
definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than zero but less than 2 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than zero but less than one million sperm per milliliter.

name: Mild oligozoospermia
definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 30 but less than 39 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 10 but less than 15 million sperm per milliliter.

name: Moderate oligozoospermia
definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 10 but less than 29 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 5 but less than 10 million sperm per milliliter.

name: Severe oligozoospermia
definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 2 but less than 10 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 1 but less than 5 million sperm per milliliter.

name: Iris nodule
definition: The presence of a nodule (small rounded lump of tissue) in the iris.

name: Koeppe nodules
definition: A type of iris nodule consisting of inflammatory cell precipitates which lie at the pupillary margin.
comments: Koeppe nodules can be observed in non-granulomaous and granulomatous uveitis.

name: Bussaca nodules
definition: A type of iris nodule consisting of inflammatory cell precipitates which lie on the iris surface.
comments: Bussace nodules are considered pathognomonic for granulomatous uveitis.

name: Decreased CSF copper concentration
definition: Concentration of copper in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) below the lower limit of normal.

name: Diffuse pulmonary lymphoid hyperplasia
definition: Diffuse lymphoid hyperplasia (DLH) describes the pathological entity that lies between follicular bronchiolitis and lymphocytic interstitial pneumonia (LIP). It is pathologically characterized by a diffuse peribronchiolar proliferation of hyperplastic lymphoid follicles (BALT), extended along the lymphatics to involve the interlobular septa and pleura. Unlike LIP, DHL does not show uniform involvement of the alveolar septa.

name: Ameliorated by steroid medication
definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with a steroid medication such as prednisone.

name: Triggered by levothyroxin exposure
definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by administration of levothyroxin (thyroid hormone).

name: Reduced muscle laminin alpha-2 chain staining
definition: A decreased amount of laminin alpha-2 chain in muscle tissue. This feature can be shown by immunohistochemistry or Western blotting of muscle tissue.

name: Adrenal cortical sclerosis
definition: Abnormal thickening of of the outer layer (cortex) of the adrenal gland due to fibrosis.
comments: See Figure 4 of PMID:4014441.

name: Reduced hepatic fructose-1,6-phosphate aldolase activity
definition: Concentration or activity of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate aldolase in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.

name: Pancreatic hamartoma
definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the pancreas.

name: Liver angiomyolipoma
definition: A benign liver neoplasm composed of fat, vascular, and smooth muscle elements.

name: Cardiac lipoma
definition: A lipoma that is located within a the heart.

name: Peripheral nerve polyglucosan inclusion bodies
definition: Accumulation of a poorly branched and poorly spherical amylopectin-like glycogen (polyglucosan) in peripheral nerve fibers.

name: Cardiac polyglucosan accumulation
definition: Accumulation of a poorly branched and poorly spherical amylopectin-like glycogen (polyglucosan) in myocardial tissue.

name: Cystic nephroma
definition: A benign cystic neoplasm of the kidney.
comments: The pathogenesis of cystic nephroma is controversial and there is no generally accepted classification.

name: Absent dermal elastic fibers
definition: Elastic fibers not demonstrable in skin biopsy.

name: Cleavage at junction of stratum corneum and stratum granulosum
definition: Splitting of the skin (cell-cell adhesion of keratinocytes) localized to the interface between the stratum corneum and stratum granulosum layers of the epidermis.

name: Lymphoid hyperplasia
definition: An abnormal bone marrow finding characterized by many poorly circumscribed and occasionally confluent lymphoid nodules. The nodules contain small and uniform lymphocytes with rounded nuclei, clumped chromatin, and without prominent nucleoli.
comments: The appearance of lymphoid hyperplasia may resemble that of malignant lymphoma, well-differentiated lymphocytic type.

name: Absence of epidermal lamellar bodies
definition: Lack of lamellar bodies (LBs) inthe epidermis. LBs are specialized organelles that contain pro-barrier lipids imparting a fully lamellar internal structure, but also other cargoes such as enzymes (lipid metabolizing and proteolytic), enzyme inhibitors, and antimicrobial peptides.
comments: Harlequin ichthyosis is characterized by absence of epidermial lamellar bodies.

name: Gastrointestinal granulomatosis
definition: The presence of multiple granulomas in the gastrointestinal tract (Pylorus, esophagus, jejunum, ileum, cecum, rectum, perirectal area, esophagus) as based on pathological examination. Granulomas are small 0.5 to 2 mm collections of modified macrophages called epithelioid cells usually surrounded by lymphocytes.

name: Enlarged sperm head vacuole
definition: Increased size of sperm vacuoles, which are surface concavities typically located at the the tip or middle area of sperm heads. According to the WHO Laboratory Manual for the Examination and Processing of Human Semen, sperm head vacuoles are considered abnormal when exceeding 20% of the cross-sectional area of the head. Vacuoles are found in almost all samples with normal sperm morphology; this term applies if the proportion of sperm with abnormally large vacuoles is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Ureteral hamartoma
definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the ureter.

name: Fetal methimazole exposure
definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to methimazole.

name: Fetal procarbazine exposure
definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to procarbazine.

name: Fetal fluorouracil exposure
definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to fluorouracil.

name: Fetal cytarabine exposure
definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to cytarabine.

name: Fetal tetracycline exposure
definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to tetracycline.

name: Fetal quinine exposure
definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to quinine.

name: Fetal cyclophosphamide exposure
definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to cyclophosphamide.

name: Fetal metronidazole exposure
definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to metronidazole.

name: Fetal phenobarbital exposure
definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to phenobarbital.

name: Fetal phenytoin exposure
definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to phenytoin.

name: Periumbilical
definition: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are located at or near the umbilicus (belly button).

name: Maternal obesity during pregnancy
definition: A history of obesity, which can be defined as a body mass index of 30 or greater, in the mother of a fetus or index patient.

name: Maternal amniocentesis
definition: A history of amniocentesis having been performed in the mother of a fetus or index patient.
comments: Complications of amniocentesis are rare but include fetal loss, amniotic fluid leak, fetal lung hypoplasia, and fetal injuries like bleeding from the cord, ocular injuries, and postural deformities like talipes equinovarus (clubfoot).

name: Typified by highly variable age of onset
definition: Description of conditions in which age of onset is highly variable even in family members who share the same disease-associated variant or variants.

name: Abnormal leukocyte enzyme concentration or activity
definition: Concentration or activity of an enzyme as measured in leukocytes is above or below the limits of normal.

name: Reduced tissue beta-glucuronidase activity
definition: Concentration or activity of beta-glucuronidase (EC 3.2.1.31) below the lower limit of normal. FECH enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including cultured fibroblasts and leukocytes.

synonyms.text: Reduced beta-glucuronidase activity in cultured fibroblasts

name: Reduced leukocyte alpha-L-fucosidase activity
definition: Concentration or activity of an alpha-L-fucosidase as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.
comments: This feature is characteristic of fucosidosis.

name: Reduced leukocyte arylsulfatase B activity
definition: Concentration or activity of an arylsulfatase B as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.
comments: This finding is characteristic of mucopolysaccharidosis type VI (MPS6). Reduced arylsulfatase activity can also be measured in cultured fibroblasts.

name: Reduced leukocyte steroid sulfatase activity
definition: Concentration or activity of an arylsulfatase C as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.
comments: Reduced activity of steroid sulfatase, also called arylsulfatase C, is characteristic of X-linked ichthyosis.

name: Reduced leukocyte arylsulfatase A activity
definition: Concentration or activity of the lysosomal enzyme arylsulfatase A (EC 3.1.6.8) as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.
comments: This finding is characteristic of metachromatic leukodystrophy. Reduced activity can also be measured in cultured fibroblasts.

name: Decreased alpha-galactosidase A activity
definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-galactosidase below the lower limit of normal.
comments: Fabry disease is a lysosomal storage disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the X-linked GLA (alpha Galactosidase A) gene (Xq22.1).

name: Positive fecal parasite test
definition: Demonstration of parasite in stool specimen, e.g., Parasites present on wet mount of stool.e

synonyms.text: Parasites present on wet mount of stool

name: Positive stool infectious agent test
definition: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in stool positive.

name: Positive stool giardia antigen
definition: Test for giardia antigen in stool such as immune assay or DFA positive.

name: Entamoeba histolytica antibody positive in stool
definition: Demonstration of antibody directed against Entamoeba histolytica in stool.

name: Reduced erythrocyte free porphyrin concentration
definition: Concentration of porphyrin in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.

name: Reduced circulating urocanic acid concentration
definition: The concentration of urocanic acid in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Decreased urinary epinephrine level
definition: The concentration of epinephrine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Decreased CSF epinephrine concentration
definition: Concentration of epinephrine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

name: Decreased circulating epinephrine concentration
definition: Concentration of epinephrin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: Decreased circulating norepinephrine concentration
definition: Concentration of norepinephrin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: Decreased urinary norepinephrine level
definition: The concentration of norepinephrine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Decreased urinary metaepinephrine level
definition: The concentration of metanephrine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Decreased CSF metanephrine concentration
definition: Concentration of metanephrine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

name: Decreased circulating metanephrine concentration
definition: Concentration of metanephrin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: Ovarian mass
definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the ovary. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
comments: An ovarian mass may be initially found upon ultrasound, CT, or MRI investigation.

name: Adrenal mass
definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the adrenal gland. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: Uterine mass
definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the uterus. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: Prostatic calculus
definition: Calcium deposits in the prostate gland.
comments: Most cases of prostatic calculi are not accompanied by symptoms. Therefore, most cases are found incidentally during the diagnosis of BPH using transrectal ultrasonography.

name: Decreased portal vein velocity
definition: A reduction in the velocity of portal venous flow, generally measured by Doppler ultrasound. Portal venous flow is normally towards the liver with peak systolic velocities in the range of 20-40 cm/s.

name: Uterine cervix mass
definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the cervis of the uterus. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: Abnormal urinary uromodulin level
definition: The concentration of uromodulin (also known as Tamm Horsfall protein) in the urine, normalized for usine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.

name: Decreased urinary uromodulin level
definition: The concentration of uromodulin (also known as Tamm Horsfall protein) in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Increased urine phenylacetylglutamine level
definition: The concentration of phenylacetylglutamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Decreased urine guanidinoacetic acid level
definition: The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Positive urine infectious agent nucleic acid test
definition: Detection of DNA and RNA originating from an infectious agent (bacteria, viruses, parasites and fungi) in the urine.

name: Positive CMV urine nucleic acid test
definition: Detection of Cytomegalovirus (CMV) nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

synonyms.text: Positive cytomegalovirus urine nucleic acid test

name: Positive Neisseria gonorrhoeae urine nucleic acid test
definition: Detection of Neisseria gonorrhoeae nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

synonyms.text: Neisseria gonorrhoeae PCR positive in urine

name: Positive enterovirus urine nucleic acid test
definition: Detection of enterovirus nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

name: Elevated brain glycine level by MRS
definition: An increase in the level of glycine in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

name: Elevated brain polyol compounds by MRS
definition: An increase in the level of polyol compounds in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

name: Elevated brain gamma-aminobutyric acid by MRS
definition: An increase in the level of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

name: History of recent anticoagulant ingestion
definition: Medical history of ingestion of anticoagulants prior to presentation.

name: Decreased circulating antidiuretic hormone concentration
definition: Concentration of antidiuretic hormone, also known as vasopressin, is below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.

name: Elevated circulating growth hormone-releasing hormone concentration
definition: Concentration of growth hormone-releasing hormone above the upper limit of normal in the blood circulation.

name: Abnormal amniotic fluid protein concentration
definition: Any deviation of the concentration of a protein in the amniotic fluid from normal limits

name: Decreased amniotic fluid alpha-fetoprotein concentration
definition: Concentration of alpha-fetoprotein in the amniotic fluid below lower limit of normal.

name: Increased circulating vitamin E concentration
definition: Concentration of vitamin E in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Abnormal circulating calcitonin concentration
definition: Concentration of calcitonin, a 32-amino acid polypeptide hormone that is produced primarily by the parafollicular cells of the thyroid, in the blood circulation outside of normal limits.

name: Decreased circulating calcitonin concentration
definition: Concentration of calcitonin, a 32-amino acid polypeptide hormone that is produced primarily by the parafollicular cells of the thyroid, in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: Decreased circulating thyrotropin releasing hormone concentration
definition: Concentration of thyrotropin releasing hormone below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.

synonyms.text: Thyrotropin releasing hormone (TRH) low in blood

name: Elevated circulating uroporphyrin concentration
definition: Concentration of uroporphyrin in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Increased urine pentacarboxylporphyrin level
definition: Concentration of pentacarboxylporphyrin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Increased urine hexacarboxylporphyrin level
definition: Concentration of hexacarboxylporphyrin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Increased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone concentration
definition: Concentration of dehydroepiandrosterone in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Increased erythrocyte coproporphyrin concentration
definition: Concentration of coproporphyrin in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal.

name: Increased erythrocyte uroproporphyrin concentration
definition: Concentration of uroproporphyrin in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal.

name: Decreased circulating apolipoprotein E concentration
definition: The concentration of apolipoprotein E in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

synonyms.text: Decreased apolipoprotein E level in blood
Reduced apolipoprotein E level in blood

name: Elevated circulating apolipoprotein E concentration
definition: The concentration of apolipoprotein E in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

synonyms.text: Elevated apolipoprotein E level in blood
Increased apolipoprotein E level in blood

name: Acrosomal hypoplasia
definition: Reduction in the size of the acrosome of the head of spermatozoa.
comments: The acrosome is a unique membranous organelle located over the anterior part of the sperm nucleus that is highly conserved throughout evolution. This acidic vacuole contains a number of hydrolytic enzymes that, when secreted, help the sperm penetrate the egg's coats. See Figure 23 of PMID:3311822.

name: Oocyte maturation arrest
definition: Oocyte maturation arrest (OMA) can manifest as failed in vitro fetilization/intracytoplasmic sperm injection (IVF/ICSI) attempts using affected oocytes.
comments: Oocyte maturation occurs through a series of molecular and morphological changes. Oocytes are initially arrested at the diplotene stage of prophase I, at which point they are referred to as germinal vesicle (GV) oocytes. Upon a surge in luteinizing hormone, GV oocytes exit prophase I and resume meiosis, and this is followed by chromatin condensation and breakdown of the nuclear envelope. Coupled with spindle formation and chromosome alignment, oocytes enter into meiosis I (when they are referred to as MI oocytes). MI is completed by extrusion of the first polar body. Oocytes then enter into meiosis II (when they are referred to as MII oocytes) but arrest at metaphase of MII until fertilization. In clinical in vitro fertilization (IVF) and intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI), first polar body (PB1) oocytes are regarded as indicative of MII oocytes, which can be used for fertilization. Oocyte maturation arrest occurs at different stages, including the GV stage and MI, leading to female infertility.

name: Abnormal anus morphology
definition: A structural anomaly of the anus.

name: Abnormal anus physiology
definition: A functional anomaly of the anus.

name: Weak anal sphincter tone
definition: Reduced muscle tone of the sphincter of the anus.

name: Reduced muscle 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase activity
definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase in muscle tissue.

name: Reduced liver 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase activity
definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase in liver tissue.

name: Nasal mucosa vasculitis
definition: Inflammation of blood vessels in the mucosa of the nasal cavity.

name: Pituitary blastoma
definition: Pituitary blastoma is a distinctive anterior hypophyseal tumor of infants
comments: Pituitary blastoma presents in infants younger than 24 months, most frequently with Cushing syndrome and elevated adrenocorticotropin (ACTH) and occasionally with ophthalmoplegia, signs of increased intracranial pressure, diabetes insipidus, and thyrotropin deficit. An often large solid or cystic/solid mass arises from the sella with extension into the hypothalamus and may encompass the optic chiasm and/or cavernous sinuses. Pathologically, the tumors exhibit arrested pituitary development and uncontrolled proliferation and are composed of Rathke epithelium, folliculostellate cells, small primitive cells, and secretory cells with ACTH or, less often, growth hormone immunoexpression.

name: Peripheral axon spheroid formation
definition: Axonal spheroids are bubble-like biological features that form on most degenerating axons.
comments: They often contain cytoskeletal elements and organelles, and, depending on the pathological insult, can colocalize with disease-related proteins such as amyloid precursor protein (APP), ubiquitin, and motor proteins. Initial formation of axonal spheroids depends on the disruption of axonal and membrane tension governed by cytoskeleton structure and calcium levels. Shortly after spheroid formation, the engulfment signal, phosphatidylserine (PS), is exposed on the outer leaflet of spheroid plasma membrane, suggesting an important role for axonal spheroids in phagocytosis and debris clearance during degeneration.

name: Reduced liver carboxylesterase 1 activity
