definition: Activity of the enzyme carboxylesterase 1 in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.

name: Abnormal dermis morphology
definition: A structural anomaly of the dermis, the layer of skin that lies beneath the epidermis and above the subcutaneous layer.

name: Perivascular dermis hyaline deposition
definition: Deposition of a largely amorphous hyaline (transparent and homogeneous) substance around blood vessels in the dermis layer of the skin.
comments: See Figure 4 of PMID:11298373

name: Perivascular small intestinal hyaline deposition
definition: Deposition of a largely amorphous hyaline (transparent and homogeneous) substance around blood vessels in the wall of the small intestine.

name: Large keratohyaline granules
definition: Abnormally large keratohyalin granules (KHG). KHG are typically present in the stratum granulosum of the epidermal layer of the skin (and epithelium of the mucosae). KHG are protein structures found in the keratinocytes of the stratum granulosum.
comments: The chief function of keratohyaline granules seems to be cross-linking of keratin filaments which creates the tight barrier that is the epidermis.

name: Decreased muscle lipoic acid content
definition: Reduced amount of lipoic acid in muscle tissue.

name: Reduced hepatic cystathionine gamma-lyase activity
definition: Activity of cystathionine gamma-lyase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

name: Digestive system neoplasm
definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the digestive system.

name: Lumbar spondylosis
definition: Arthrosis, i.e., of degenerative joint disease, affecting the lumbar vertebral column.
comments: When osteoarthritis affects the spine, it is known as spondylosis.

name: Decreased circulating acid maltase activity
definition: Activity of the enzyme acid maltase (also known as alpha-1,4-glucosidase) below the lower limit of normal.
comments: This finding is characteristic of Glycogen storage disease II (Pompe disease).

name: Abnormal circulating 7-dehydrocholesterol concentration
definition: Concentration of 7-dehydrocholesterol in the blood circulation outside the limits of normal.

name: Decreased circulating 7-dehydrocholesterol concentration
definition: Concentration of 7-dehydrocholesterol in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: Elevated circulating lathosterol concentration
definition: Concentration of lathosterol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
comments: Lathosterol is an intermeditate in the synthesis of cholesterol.

name: Elevated circulating desmosterol concentration
definition: Concentration of desmosterol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Decreased circulating sialic acid concentration
definition: Concentration of sialic acid in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
comments: Sialic acid is a nine-carbon monosaccharide.

name: Purulent synovial fluid
definition: The synovial fluid (also known as synovia, i.e., the fluid found in the cavities of synovial joints) contains increased quantities of white blood cells.

name: Muscle fiber calsequestrin 1-containing inclusion bodies
definition: The presence of inclusion bodies within the cytoplasm of muscle cells that demonstrate immunoreactivity for calsequestrin 1.

name: Palatine myxoma
definition: A myxoma (A benign tumor composed of myxomatous tissue composed of loosely-arranged spindle, polygonal, and stellate cells) localized to the palate. Clinically, such tumors may present as a sessile nodule on the hard palate.

name: Vaginal myxoma
definition: A myxoma (tumor of primitive connective tissue) localized in the vagina.

name: Decreased dermal collagen
definition: Abnormally reduced amount of collagen fibers in the dermis.
comments: See Figure 4C of PMID:29606302.

name: Irregularly shaped keratohyaline granules
definition: Abnormal shape of keratohyaline granules in dermal keratinocytes.
comments: Normal keratohyaline granules demonstrate a stellate and angulated shape See Figure S2 (Electron microscopy of the granular layer) of PMID:29758285.

name: Tubular shadows
definition: Tubular shadows are characterized by a complete absence of cells in the testicular tubules, meaning that germ cells as well as somatic Sertoli cells are absent. The cells have been replaced by hyalinization.

name: Multiple eyelid margin cysts
definition: Presence of many apocrine hidrocystoma (cysts) on the margins of the eyelids.

name: Altered location of the longitudinal column in the fibrous sheath
definition: The fibrous sheath is a structure in the midpiece of the sperm flagellum surrounding the outer dense fibers. It comprises two longitudinal columns and transverse ribs. In case of altered location of the longitudinal column in the fibrous sheath the symmetrical structure is lost, most commonly with the columns not being opposite to each other, which can be visualized by electron microscopy.

name: Uterine myxoma
definition: A myxoma (tumor of primitive connective tissue) localized to the uterus.

name: Uterine cervix myxoma
definition: A myxoma (tumor of primitive connective tissue) localized to the the cervix of the uterus.

name: Typified by complete penetrance
definition: Penetrance describes the proportion of genotype positive individuals that develop disease given a lifespan of 80 years. For example, penetrance of Neurofibromatosis type 1 is close to 100%.
comments: Description of conditions in which all individuals with a given genotype exhibit the disease within a lifespan of 80 years.

name: Osteochondromyxoma
definition: A rare benign chondroid and osteoid matrix-producing neoplasm of bone characterized by extensive myxoid changes. OMX originate from bony cortices and have been observed in the nasal region, as well as the tibia and radius.
comments: Osteochondromyxoma is a rare manifestation of Carney complex.

name: Gangliocytoma
definition: A low-grade central nervous system tumor composed of dysplastic ganglion cells, usually presenting in children or young adults and located in the cerebral hemispheres.

name: Duodenal gastrinoma
definition: A gastrinoma, a neuroendocrine tumors characterized by the secretion of gastrin with resultant excessive gastric acid production, that is localized to the duodenum.

name: Thymic carcinoid tumor
definition: A primary thymic neuroendocrine tumor.

name: Bone marrow eosinophilia
definition: Count of eosinophils in the bone marrow above the upper limit of normal.
comments: See Figure 1E of PMID:27684977.

name: Exacerbated by lithium exposure
definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with lithium.

name: Reduced hepatic glycogen debrancher enzyme activity
definition: Activity of glycogen debrancher enzyme (also known as amylo-1,6-glucosydase, 4-alpha-glucantransferase) in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.
comments: Glycogen debrancher enzyme degrades glycogen branches and thereby releases glucose in a two step reaction. Debranching enzyme activity can be measured in either blood cells (leukocytes or erythrocytes), skin fibroblasts, or liver or muscle biopsy.

name: Asymmetrical insertion of the midpiece into the head
definition: Insertion of the neck and midpiece into the head of a spermatozoon on an axis that diverges from the midline axis of the spermatozoon head. This term applies if the proportion of spermatozoa with this defect is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Bent sperm neck
definition: Sharply angled insertion of the neck and midpiece into the head of a spermatozoon. This term applies if the proportion of spermatozoa with this feature is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urine 3,6-epoxydicarboxylic acid level
definition: The concentration of 3,6-epoxydicarboxylic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Gallbladder biliary sludging
definition: Presence of biliary sludge (a mixture of particulate solids that have precipitated from bile) in the gallbladder. Such sediment consists of cholesterol crystals, calcium bilirubinate pigment, and other calcium salts. Sludge is usually detected on transabdominal ultrasonography.

name: Exacerbated by amiodarone exposure
definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with amiodarone.

name: Ureteral mass
definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the ureter. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: Wide cavum septum pellucidum
definition: Width of the cavum septum pellucidum above the upper limit of normal, which is defined as a separation of greater than one cm of the leaves of the cavum septum pellucidum.

name: Hypoplastic trochlear nerve
definition: Underdevelopment of the trochlear nerve, which is the fourth cranial nerve and one of the ocular motor nerves that controls eye movement.

name: Thymic cyst
definition: A closed sac of tissue (cyst) located in the thymus. Thymic cysts are a rare, benign anomaly, are usually asymptomatic, and mostly occur in the anterior mediastinum .

name: Uterine cyst
definition: A closed sack of tissue (cyst) located in the uterus.

name: Urinary bladder mass
definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the urinary bladder. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: Endosteal scalloping
definition: A series of indentations or erosions on a normally smooth margin of the inner layer of the cortex (i.e. the endosteum) of bones.

name: Urinary bladder hamartoma
definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the urinary bladder.

name: Peritoneal mass
definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the peritoneal cavity. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: Fallopian tube mass
definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the Fallopian tube. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: Aplasia of the pyramids of the medulla oblongata
definition: Congenital absence of the pyramids, that is, of the paired structures located at the medial aspect of the ventral medulla that flank the anterior median fissure.

name: Bathrocephaly
definition: A deformity of the posterior skull with bulging of the midportion of the occipital bone that is often associated with a benign variant of the mendosal suture.

name: Occipital horn
definition: Downward pointing exostoses of the occipital bone situated in the tendinous insertions of the sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles.
comments: See Figure 2 of PMID:31336972.

name: Absent pituitary stalk
definition: A developmental defect characterized by failure to develop of the pituitary stalk. The pituitary stalk, also known as the infundibulum or infundibular stalk, is the connection between the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland.
comments: See Figure 1 and 2 of PMID:25250085.

name: Abnormal pituitary stalk morphology
definition: A structural anomaly of the pituitary stalk, also known as the infundibulum or infundibular stalk, is the connection between the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland.

name: Interrupted pituitary stalk
definition: A developmental defect characterized by a discontinuity of the pituitary stalk. The pituitary stalk, also known as the infundibulum or infundibular stalk, is the connection between the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland.

name: Facial synkinesis
definition: Unintentional movement in one area of the face produced during intentional movement of another area of the face.
comments: For instance, facial synkinesis may manifest as hypertonic contractures and synkinetic movements such as eye closure with volitional movement of the mouth or midfacial movement during volitional or reflexive eye closure.

name: Synkinesis
definition: Unintentional movement in one area of the body produced during intentional movement of another area of the body.

name: Exposure to birds
definition: History of exposure to birds.

name: Perianal anesthesia
definition: Loss of sensation to the area of buttocks, perianal space and thighs.
comments: This feature may be observed with cauda equina syndrome as a collection of acute symptoms mostly occurring secondary to a large disk herniations leading to neuropathy of multiple lumbar and sacral nerve roots, or with spinal epidural abscess.

name: Failure of phenylephrine to induce blanching of eye redness
definition: Instillation of 2.5% phenylephrine drops into the eye does not induce blanching of eye redness. Failure to blanch suggests redness caused by scleral vessel engorgement (e.g., scleritis) or extravascular cause (e.g., hemorrhage), not episcleritis or conjunctivitis.

synonyms.text: Phenylephrine does not induce blanching of eye redness

name: Fetal alcohol exposure
definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to ethanol (alcohol).

synonyms.text: Exposure to alcohol in the womb

name: Reduced cellular cobalamin uptake
definition: Diminished ability of cells to transport cobalamine from the extracellular space to the cytoplasm.
comments: Cobalamin (Cbl. also known as vitamin B12) plays a role in the recycling of folate for single carbon exchange reactions, purine and pyrimidine synthesis, and methylation of homocysteine for the production of S-adenosylmethionine. The absorption, blood transport and cellular uptake of Cbl are complex processes involving multiple proteins and receptors. Transcobalamine binds to Cbl to protect it from acid degradation in the stomach.

name: Focal necrotic brainstem lesion
definition: A localized area of cell death, often accompanied by infiltration of inflammatory cells, in the brainstem.

name: Focal necrotic optic nerve lesion
definition: A localized area of cell death, often accompanied by infiltration of inflammatory cells, in the optic nerve.

name: Focal necrotic thalamus lesion
definition: A localized area of cell death, often accompanied by infiltration of inflammatory cells, in the thalamus.

name: Interstitial dermal edema
definition: Accumulation of fluid in the interstitial spaces of the skin. This finding can be appreciated my microscopic examination of a skin biopsy.

name: Shoulder abduction contracture
comments: A type of shoulder contracture characterized by decreased adduction movement of shoulder, that is, by a by a chronic reduction in active and passive ability to move the arm via the shoulder joint away from the median plane of the body.

name: Shoulder external rotation contracture
definition: A type of shoulder contracture characterized by decreased internal rotation of shoulder, that is, by a chronic reduction in active and passive ability to internally rotate the humerus at the shoulder joint (if the arm is flexed at the elbow, Internal rotation of the shoulder rotates the forearm towards the center of the body).

synonyms.text: External rotation contracture of the shoulder joint

name: Thumb adduction contracture
definition: A type of thumb contracture characterized by a chronic reduction in active and passive ability of the metacarpal-phalangeal and/or interphalangeal joints of the thumb to bring from medial side to neutral position, where the neutral position for the thumb is when the distal and proximal segments of the thumb joint are in linear alignment.

name: Hip internal rotation contracture
definition: The inability to rotate the proximal or upper limb segment laterally past anatomic neutral moving away from the midline, when viewed from anteriorly. Anatomic neutral position is defined as the trans-epicondylar axis of the distal humerus (for upper extremity) or femur (for lower extremity) is parallel to the sagittal plane of the body. This type of contracture is characterized by a turning of the knee from a neutral position to one facing more the midline, where the neutral position for the hip is with knee pointing directly anteriorly (less than or equal to 45 degrees).

name: Reduced tissue fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase activity
definition: Activity of fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase (EC 3.1.3.11) below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including liver and leukocytes.

name: Reduced hepatic carbamoylphosphate synthetase 1 activity
definition: Activity of carbamoylphosphate synthetase 1 in the liver below the lower limit of normal.
comments: Carbamoyl phosphate synthetase I (EC 6.3.4.16) is the rate-limiting enzyme that catalyzes the first committed step of the hepatic urea cycle by synthesizing carbamoyl phosphate from ammonia, bicarbonate, and 2 molecules of ATP.

name: Reduced intraepidermal small nerve fiber density
definition: Reduced number of small nerve fibers in the skin.
comments: Small fibers travel too slowly, and their conduction responses cannot be captured by a nerve conduction study, which is a routine test performed to evaluate large sensory and motor nerve fibers. Therefore, a skin biopsy is often used to assess small sensory nerve fibers in the skin. Skin biopsy is a minimally invasive procedure that may also be used to evaluate intraepidermal nerve fiber density. Skin specimens are typically obtained by a 3 mm punch biopsy at the distal leg and thigh and are then sent for laboratory analysis. Small fiber neuropathy may be diagnosed if the intraepidermal nerve fiber density is less than normal.

name: Femoral artery duplication
definition: A developmental defect characterized by the presence of a supernumerary femoral artery.

name: Intracellular accumulation of collagen VII
definition: Collagen VII is the major molecular constituent of anchoring fibrils in the skin. Collagen VII is synthesized as three identical pro-alpha1(VII) polypeptide chains, which are hydroxylated and glycosylated in a coordinated manner and then fold into triple-helical procollagen VII in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER). Mature collagen VII undergoes a multistep fibril polymerization process to form the anchoring fibrils. Mutant pro-alpha1(VII) polypeptide chains or procollagen VII molecules do not pass the ER quality control and are retained in the ER or designated for ubiquitin-proteasome degradation resulting in reduced amounts of collagen VII in the skin.
comments: See Figure 2B of PMID:8288900.

name: Reduced reticular lamina anchoring fibril density
definition: Diminished amount of the anchoring fibrils in the basement membrane zone that normally attach the epithelium to the basement membrane.

name: Reduced lamina lucida anchoring filament density
definition: Diminished amount of the anchoring filaments that normally bridge the lamina lucida and insert into the lamina densa in the cutaneous basement membrane zone.

name: Reduced epidermal keratin 5 protein expression
definition: Amount of keratin 5 in the epidermis below the lower limit of normal. The findiong is typically ascertained by immunofluorescent microscopy.

name: Reduced epidermal keratin 14 protein expression
definition: Amount of keratin 14 in the epidermis below the lower limit of normal. The findiong is typically ascertained by immunofluorescent microscopy.

name: Reduced epidermal keratin protein expression
definition: Amount of one or more keratins in the epidermis below the lower limit of normal. The findiong is typically ascertained by immunofluorescent microscopy.

name: Reduced hepatic alanine-glyoxylate aminotransferase activity
definition: Activity of alanine-glyoxylate aminotransferase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

name: Hepatic sinusoidal dilatation
definition: Presence of an increased amount of blood in the hepatic capillaries.
comments: Sinusoidal dilatation and congestion (SDC) in liver biopsy is often the result of venous outflow impairment. This impairment can occur at the level of the small hepatic veins (veno-occlusive disease), large hepatic veins (Budd-Chiari syndrome), or the heart (right-sided heart failure, tricuspid valve disease, constrictive pericarditis). See Figure in PMID:15270610

name: Thin spermatozoon midpiece
definition: The cross-sectional size (diameter) of the midpiece of the spermatozoon is below the lower limit of normal. This term applies if the proportion of spermatozoa with this defect is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Thick spermatozoon midpiece insertion
definition: Increased width of the midpiece of the spermatozoon. The midpiece is the structure that is located between the head and the flagella (tail) of the spermatozoon. This term applies if the width of the midpiece increases progressively from the flagella to the head and if the proportion of individual spermatozoa with this anomaly is above the upper limit of normal.
comments: See Figure 2.10i of the WHO laboratory manual for the examination and processing of human semen, Sixth edition (2021).

name: Shoulder adduction contracture
definition: A type of shoulder contracture characterized by a chronic reduction in the active and passive ability to abduct the shoulder. This results in the shoulders being closer to midline. The affected individual is not able to position the shoulders away from the body.

name: Occupational exposure history
definition: Exposure to a substance that results from the performance of an employee's duties.

name: Occupational silver exposure
definition: A history of exposure to silver that has occurred in relation to performance of job duties.

name: Abnormal femoral artery morphology
definition: Any structural abnormality of the femoral artey, a large blood vessel that provides oxygenated blood to lower extremity structures and in part to the lower anterior abdominal wall.

name: Extrahepatic bile duct fibrosis
definition: Accumulation of fibrous connective tissue (collagen) in the extrahepatic bile ducts.

name: Elevated circulating short-chain acylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of short-chain acylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acylcarnitines are classified according to the number of carbon atoms in the acyl-chain. Short chain acylcarnitines have between two and five carbon atoms in the acyl-chain (C2-C5),

name: Elevated circulating C4-acylcarnitine concentration
definition: The concentration of C4-acylcarnitine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
comments: C4 acylcarnitines have a four-carbon acyl chain. C4 acylcarnitines include butyrylcarnitine (C4:0 acylcarnitine) and isobutyrylcarnitine (C4:1 acylcarnitine).

name: Elevated circulating medium-chain acylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of medium-chain acylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acylcarnitines are classified according to the number of carbon atoms in the acyl-chain. Medium-chain acylcarnitines have between six and twelve carbon atoms in the acyl-chain (C6-C12),

name: Elevated circulating long-chain acylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of long-chain acylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acylcarnitines are classified according to the number of carbon atoms in the acyl-chain. Long-chain acylcarnitines have between thirteen and twenty carbon atoms in the acyl-chain (C13-C20),

name: Elevated circulating C5 acylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of C5 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C5 acylcarnitines have a five-carbon acyl chain.

name: Elevated circulating C18 acylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of C18 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C18 acylcarnitines have a eighteen-carbon acyl chain.

name: Elevated circulating C16 acylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of C16 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C16 acylcarnitines have a sixteen-carbon acyl chain.

name: Elevated circulating very long-chain acylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of very long-chain acylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acylcarnitines are classified according to the number of carbon atoms in the acyl-chain. Very long-chain acylcarnitines have twentyone or more carbon atoms in the acyl-chain (C21 and higher),

name: Elevated circulating acetylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of acetylcarnitine (C2 acylcarnitine) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Acetylcarnitine has a two-carbon acyl chain.

name: Elevated circulating methylmalonylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of methylmalonylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxyhexadecanoylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxyhexadecanoylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated circulating C6 acylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of C6 acylcarnitines in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. C6 acylcarnitines have a six-carbon acyl chain.

name: Elevated circulating methylglutarylcarnitine concentration
definition: The concentration of O-methylglutarylcarnitine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxyisovalerylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxyisovalerylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated circulating 3-hydroxyhexanoylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxyhexanoylcarnitine (C6-OH) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated circulating carnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of carnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated circulating tiglylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of tiglylcarnitine (C5:1) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: Reduced circulating acetylcarnitine concentration
definition: Concentration of acetylcarnitine (C2 acylcarnitine) in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. Acetylcarnitine has a two-carbon acyl chain.

name: Decreased circulating octadecenoylcarnitine concentration
definition: The concentration of octadecenoylcarnitine (C18:1 acylcarnitine) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Absent pigmentation of chest
definition: Lack of skin pigmentation (coloring) of the chest.

synonyms.text: Lack of skin coloring on chest
Lack of skin colouring on chest
Failure of development of facial bones
Failure of development of facial skeleton

name: Hyperparakeratosis
definition: Histological term to illustrate the combined presence of parakeratosis and hyperkeratosis. Abnormal keratinization of the epidermal stratum corneum (horny layer) with increased keratin formation and preservation of the nuclei in the superficial cells.

name: Chromosome breakage
definition: Elevated rate of chromosomal breakage or interchanges occurring either spontaneously or following exposure to various DNA-damaging agents. This feature may be assayed by treatment of cultured lymphocytes with agents such as chemical mutagens, irradiation, and alkylating agents.

synonyms.text: High frequency of chromosome breaks in lymphocytes

name: Increased activity of mitochondrial respiratory chain
obsolete Radial deviation of the thumb
Chorioretinal hypopigmentation
definition: Focal or global or heterogeneous loss of choroidal and retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) pigmentation in the absence of atrophy.

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the fifth metatarsal bone
Abnormality of the second metatarsal bone

synonyms.text: Abnormality of the 2nd long bone of foot

name: Abnormality of the fourth metatarsal bone

synonyms.text: Abnormality of the 4th long bone of foot

name: Onychogryphosis of fingernail
definition: Thickened fingernails.

name: Toenail onycholysis
definition: Painless and spontaneous separation of a toenail from the nail bed.

name: Aplasia of the eccrine sweat glands
Hypoplasia of the eccrine sweat glands
obsolete Aplasia of the left hemidiaphragm
Macular edema
definition: Thickening of the retina that takes place due to accumulation of extracellular fluid in the macula as a nonspecific response to blood-retinal barrier breakdown. It can either have a cystoid aspect in the fovea, or a more diffuse aspect.
comments: Macular edema is a common pathological response to a wide variety of ocular insults, most commonly after intraocular (e.g. cataract) surgery or in association with retinal vascular (e.g. diabetic eye disease, retinal vein occlusion) or inflammatory (e.g. uveitis) disease.

synonyms.text: Failure of development of upper eyelashes

name: Decreased adipose tissue
definition: The amount of adipose tissue (fat) in the body or a part of the body is below the lower limit of normal.

name: obsolete Abnormal morphology of bones of the upper limbs
obsolete Abnormal morphology of bones of the lower limbs

synonyms.text: Abnormal morphology of bones of the lower limbs
Abnormal shape of bones of the lower limbs
Abnormal morphology of bones of the upper limbs
Abnormal shape of bones of the upper limbs

name: Abnormal morphology of ulna
definition: Any structural anomaly of the ulna, a bone of the forearm the extends from the elbow to the little finger.

name: obsolete Abnormal concentration of calcium in blood
Abnormal circulating creatine kinase activity
definition: Any deviation from the normal activity of creatine kinase in the blood circulation.

synonyms.text: Abnormal levels of creatine kinase in blood

name: Happy demeanor
definition: A conspicuously happy disposition, characterized by frequent smiling and laughing, which may be contextually inappropriate or unrelated to the situation.

name: obsolete Toe walking
definition: Toe walking is a pattern of walking in which a person walks on balls of his or her feet, with no contact between the heels and ground. Toe-walking is common in children who are learning to walk, but most children outgrow it around the age of two years. This term refers to the persistence of toe-walking beyond the usual age.

name: Abnormal circulating renin concentration
definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of renin in the blood, a central hormone in the control of blood pressure and various other physiological functions.

name: Abnormal circulating folate concentration
definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of folate in the blood circulation.
comments: Folate is an essential water-soluble vitamin (vitamin B9) that is found in green leafy vegetables, cereals, legumes, and fruit. As a major methyl group donor, it plays an important role in one-carbon metabolism and is involved in DNA, RNA, and protein synthesis, in addition to its significant role in energy production and normal cell division. Low blood folate concentration is associated with an increased risk for neural tube defects during pregnancy.

name: Abnormal lymphocyte count
definition: Any abnormality in the total number of lymphocytes in the blood.

name: Abnormal total natural killer cell count
definition: Abnormal increase or decrease of total natural killer (NK) cells, commonly characterized as CD3-CD19- and CD16+ or CD56+ lymphocytes, in the blood, per microlitre, or altered NK cell phenotype, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group, measured ex vivo.

synonyms.text: Abnormal number of natural killer cells
Abnormality of natural killer cell count

comments: In human peripheral blood, five NK cell subpopulations can be defined on the basis of the relative expression of the markers CD16 and CD56: (1) CD56bright CD16- (50-70% of CD56bright), (2) CD56bright CD16dim (30-50% of CD56bright), (3) CD56dim CD16-, (4) CD56dim CD16bright, and (5) CD56- CD16bright. In healthy individuals, populations (3) and (5) are numerically in the minority.

name: Abnormal tympanic membrane morphology
definition: Any structural abnormality of the tympanic membrane
comments: The tympanic membrane is considered to be the border of middle and outer ear.

name: Asymmetry of the size of ears

synonyms.text: Asymmetry of the size of ears

name: Asymmetry of the shape of the ears

synonyms.text: Asymmetry of the shape of the ears

name: Asymmetry of the position of the ears
Neoplasm of the outer ear
definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the outer ear.

name: Neoplasm of the inner ear
definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the inner ear.

name: Neoplasm of the ceruminal gland
definition: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the ceruminal gland.

name: Cutaneous atresia of the external auditory canal
Osseous atresia of the external auditory canal
Acquired stenosis of the external ear canal
definition: Stenosis or narrowing of the external ear canal (EAC) occurs lateral to the tympanic membrane resulting in a skin lined blind canal.

synonyms.text: Cutaneous stenosis of the external auditory canal

comments: Acquired stenosis of the external ear canal typically presents as recurrent otorrhea, conductive hearing loss, often with significant cerumen impaction and ear canal cholesteatoma. Different etiologies such as chronic otitis externa, dermatologic diseases, iatrogenic (previous ear surgery or radiotherapy) or accidental rauma, tumor and inflammation lead to scarring/fibrosis and subsequent stenosis of the ear canal.

name: Osseous stenosis of the external auditory canal
definition: A narrowing of the bony part of the ear canal, which can be congenital or acquired through causes like chronic infections, trauma, or radiation therapy.

synonyms.text: Morphological abnormality of the horizontal semicircular canal
Morphological abnormality of the lateral semicircular canal
Morphological abnormality of the posterior semicircular canal
Morphological abnormality of the anterior semicircular canal

name: Absence of the reflex of the tensor tympani muscle
Abnormal Eustachian tube morphology
definition: A structural anomaly of the Eustachian tube (ET). The ET is a biomechanical valve between the nasopharynx and the middle ear. Physiologically, it controls the passive adaptation of the middle ear air pressure to the ambient air pressure primarily via direct muscular actions of the soft palate. In the closed state it protects the middle ear. Inadequate function of the ET causes middle ear ventilation disorders.

name: Abnormality of the reflex of the tensor tympani muscle
Abnormality of the acoustic reflex
definition: An abnormality in the reflexive contraction of the middle-ear muscles in response to sound stimulation.

name: Impairment of the the acoustic reflex
Impairment of the reflex of the tensor tympani muscle
obsolete Abnormal circulating vitamin B12 concentration
Abnormal sweat homeostasis
definition: An abnormality of the composition of sweat or the levels of its components.

name: Abnormal circulating iron concentration
definition: The concentration of iron in the blood circulation is outside the limits of normal.

name: Abnormal circulating ferritin concentration
definition: A deviation from the normal circulating concentration of ferritin. Ferritin concentration can be measured in serum or plasma.
comments: Ferritin is an iron storage protein present in all cells of the organism. A small amount is found in plasma and serum, which is a reflection of iron stores in healthy individuals. A low serum ferritin concentration is usually regarded as an indicator of iron depletion, although the interpretation of normal or high serum ferritin values is challenging in the presence of acute or chronic inflammatory processes, as ferritin is increased in iron overload states and inflammation.

name: Abnormal transferrin saturation
definition: Any abnormality in the serum transferrin saturation, which is calculated by dividing the serum iron level by total iron-binding capacity.

name: Comedonal acne
definition: A type of acne in which open and closed comedones comprise the majority of the lesions, with substantially fewer papules and pustules.

name: Mucinous histiocytosis
definition: Multiple subcutaneous non-fragile and skin-coloured papules characterized by interstitial infiltrate of spindle and epithelioid histiocytes, and mucin. There are well circumscribed aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes and mucin in the upper and middle dermis,with the histiocytes arranged between collagen bundles and separated from the epidermis by a Grenz zone.

name: Lipogranulomatosis
definition: Yellow nodules of lipoid material are deposited in the skin and mucosae. This gives rise to granulomatous reactions.
comments: Usually caused by a faulty lipid metabolism

name: Tardive dyskinesia
comments: the involuntary movements are tardive, meaning they have a slow or belated onset

name: Reduced circulating 5-oxoprolinase activity
definition: Activity or concentration of 5-oxoprolinase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme catalyzes the reaction 5-oxo-L-proline + ATP + 2 H(2)O = L-glutamate + ADP + 2 H(+) + phosphate.

name: Dystopic os odontoideum
definition: Os odontoideum is classified into two anatomic types (orthotopic and dystopic). Os odontoideum is defined as an ossicle that consists of smooth and separate caudal portions of the odontoid process. With orthotopic os odontoideum, the ossicle moves with the anterior arch of the atlas, while the dystopic type consists of an ossicle near the basion, or one that is fused with the clivus

name: L-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria
definition: An increase in the level of L-2-hydroxyglutaric acid in the urine.

name: Dicarboxylic acidemia
definition: The concentration of dicarboxylic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

synonyms.text: Elevated dicarboxylic acid level in blood
Increased dicarboxylic acid level in blood

name: Cortical myoclonus
definition: Cortical myoclonus mainly affects the distal upper limbs and face, which reflects the largest cortical representations of these body areas. It is often focal, but may be multifocal, bilateral or generalized, as a consequence of intracortical and transcallosal spreading of abnormal activity. It typically occurs on voluntary action and may affect speech and gait. Cortical myoclonic jerks are stimulus sensitive, typically to touch, but sensitivity to visual stimuli is also described. Most patients with cortical myoclonus have both positive myoclonus and NM, occurring either independently or together as a complex of the two kinds of myoclonus. If cortical myoclonus is prolonged and lasts for hours, days or weeks, it is called epilepsia partials continua and is considered to be a rare form of focal epileptic status. Focal cortical myoclonus almost always points to an underlining lesion of the sensori-motor cortex, which produces hyperexcitability (e.g. vascular, inflammatory or neoplastic).

name: Woolly scalp hair
definition: The presence of wooly hair on the scalp. The term wooly hair refers to an abnormal variant of hair that is fine, with tightly coiled curls, and often hypopigmented. Optical microscopy may reveal the presence of tight spirals and a clear diameter reduction as compared with normal hair. Electron microscopy may show flat, oval hair shafts with reduced transversal diameter.

name: Acne inversa
definition: A chronic skin condition involving the inflammation of the apocrine sweat glands, forming pimple-like bumps known as abscesses.

name: Elevated urinary 3-hydroxybutyric acid
definition: An increased amount of 3-hydroxybutyric acid in the urine.

name: Elevated urinary carboxylic acid
definition: An increased amount of carboxylic acid in the urine.

synonyms.text: Abnormality of spacing of front teeth

name: Orthokeratosis
definition: Formation of an anuclear keratin layer

name: Lipomas of eyelids
definition: Fatty tumors on the eyelids.
comments: Eyelid lipomas

name: Periostitis
definition: Inflammation of the periosteum

name: Facial papilloma
comments: A very specific feature of Costello Syndrome

name: Abnormality of extrinsic muscle of tongue
Platelet-activating factor acetylhydrolase deficiency
definition: Reduced level of platelet-activating factor acetylhydrolase.

name: Abnormal circulating phospholipid concentration
definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a phospholipid in the blood circulation.

name: Chapped lip
definition: Cracking, fissuring, and peeling of the skin of the lips.

name: Inappropriate sinus tachycardia
definition: Inappropriate sinus tachycardia is a nonparoxysmal tachyarrhythmia characterized by an increased resting heart rate (HR) and/or an exaggerated HR response to minimal exertion or a change in body posture. HR is constantly above the physiological range with no appropriate relation to metabolic or physiological demands.

name: Maculopapular exanthema
definition: A skin rash that is characterized by diffuse cutaneous erythema with areas of skin elevation. It may evolve to vesicles or papules as part of a more severe clinical entity. Different degrees of angioedema with involvement of subcutaneous tissue may also appear.

name: Neonatal sepsis
definition: Systemic inflammatory response to infection in newborn babies.

name: Osteochondrosis
definition: Abnormal growth ossification centers in children. Initially a degeneration/ necrosis followed by regeneration or recalcification.

name: Scaling skin
definition: Refers to the loss of the outer layer of the epidermis in large, scale-like flakes.

synonyms.text: Atrophy of the rectus femoris muscles

name: APUdoma
definition: An endocrine tumor arising from an APUD cell.

synonyms.text: amine precursor uptake and decarboxylation tumors
amine precursor uptake and decarboxylation tumours

name: Increased head circumference
definition: An abnormally increased head circumference in a growing child. Head circumference is measured with a nonelastic tape and comprises the distance from above the eyebrows and ears and around the back of the head. The measured HC is then plotted on an appropriate growth chart.

name: Decreased head circumference
definition: An abnormally reduced head circumference in a growing child. Head circumference is measured with a nonelastic tape and comprises the distance from above the eyebrows and ears and around the back of the head. The measured HC is then plotted on an appropriate growth chart. Microcephaly is defined as a head circumference (HC) that is great than two standard deviations below the mean of age- and gender-matched population based samples. Severe microcephaly is defined with an HC that is three standard deviations below the mean.
comments: Although HC measures skull size, it typically also reflects overall brain volume and has been described as a widely used proxy of neural growth and brain size. Brain size outside of normal values is an important risk factor for cognitive and motor delay. Microcephaly at birth has been termed primary microcephaly and that acquired after birth is secondary microcephaly.

name: Mild microcephaly
definition: Decreased occipito-frontal (head) circumference (OFC). For the microcephaly OFC must be between -3 SD and -2 SD compared to appropriate, age matched, normal standards (i.e. -3 SD <= OFC < -2 SD).

name: Encephalomalacia
definition: Encephalomalacia is the softening or loss of brain tissue after cerebral infarction, cerebral ischemia, infection, craniocerebral trauma, or other injury.

name: Motor impersistence
definition: The inability to maintain postures or positions (such as keeping eyes closed, protruding the tongue, maintaining conjugate gaze steadily in a fixed direction, or making a prolonged 'ah' sound) without repeated prompts.
comments: Damage to premotor and prefrontal regions results in motor-intentional disorders that disrupt initiation, maintenance, and termination of volitional movements. Motor impersistence (i.e., failure to maintain movement) more frequently develops following right than left hemisphere lesions. {xref="PMID:17353476", xref="DOI:10.1007/978-0-387-79948-3_2046", xref="https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199"}

name: Simultanapraxia
definition: A subset of motor impersistence, defined as the inability to perform more than two of the simple voluntary acts simultaneously, such as closing the eyes and protruding the tongue.

name: Abnormal consumption behavior
definition: Recurrent abnormal consumption of food, liquids, or objects that could have negative consequences for the individual.

name: Abnormal CSF neopterin concentration
definition: Abnormal concentration of neopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

name: Elevated CSF neopterin level
definition: Increased concentration of neopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

name: Decreased CSF neopterin level
definition: Decreased concentration of neopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

name: Abnormal circulating neopterin concentration
definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of neopterin in the blood circulation.
comments: Neopterin can be found to have abnormal level in blood, CSF, or urine.

name: Abnormal CSF pterin concentration
definition: Abnormal concentration of a pterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
comments: Pterin is a coenzyme that occurs in various forms, such as biopterin, folic acid, xanthopterin, or methanopterin.

name: Elevated CSF biopterin level
definition: Concentration of biopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

name: Decreased CSF biopterin level
definition: Concentration of biopterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) below the lower limit of normal.

name: Abnormal circulating biopterin concentration
definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of biopterin in the blood circulation.

name: Abnormal skin morphology of the palm
definition: An abnormality of the skin of the palm, that is, the skin of the front of the hand.

name: Risus sardonicus
definition: Fixed sarcastic grimace and anxious expression. Caused by spasms of the masseter and other facial muscles.
comments: Accompanied by rigidity of neck and trunk muscles and arching of back. Often observed as a sign of tetanus.

name: Hypopnea
definition: Hypopnea is referring to breathing that is abnormally shallow.
comments: Not to be confused with Hypoventilation. Hypopnea is distinct from apnea in which there is no breathing.

name: Abnormal circulating insulin concentration
definition: An abnormal concentration of insulin in the body.

name: Hypoinsulinemia
definition: A decreased concentration of insulin in the blood.

name: Elevated hemoglobin A1c
definition: An increased concentration of hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c), which is the product of nonenzymatic attachment of a hexose molecule to the N-terminal amino acid of the hemoglobin molecule. This reaction is dependent on blood glucose concentration, and therefore reflects the mean glucose concentration over the previous 8 to 12 weeks. The HbA1c level provides a better indication of long-term glycemic control than one-time blood or urinary glucose measurements.

name: Reduced total natural killer cell count
definition: The absolute count of natural killer cells in the blood, per microlitre, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Absent natural killer cells
definition: Absence of detectable circulating NK cells, commonly characterized as CD3-CD19- and CD16+ or CD56+ lymphocytes, in the blood. Usually, less than 20 cells per microlitre is considered to be an absence.

name: Abnormal size of the dental root
Maternal thrombophilia
definition: An increased tendency towards thrombosis in the mother during a pregnancy.
comments: Maternal thrombophilia has been linked to an increased incidence of placental abruption, as well as other adverse pregnancy outcomes. It is believed that the increased obstetrical risk is mediated through placental vascular dysfunction. Placental thrombosis can then result in subsequent ischemic complications, such as fetal loss, preeclampsia, and fetal growth restriction. Placental abruption has been identified as being part of the spectrum of ischemic placental disease and is postulated to be a chronic disease process (PMID:25401392).

name: Pulmonary hemorrhage
definition: Pulmonary hemorrhage is a bleeding within the lungs. Older children and adults may spit blood or bloody sputum. Neonates, infants and young children usually do not spit up blood. Anemia, pulmonary infiltrates, increasingling bloody return on BAL and the presence of hemosiderin-laden macrophages in broncho-alveolar lavage (BAL) fluid or lung biopsy can diagnose lung bleeding. Alveolar macrophages contain phagocytosed red blood cells and stain positive for hemosiderin, a product of hemoglobin degradation, after about 48-72 hours following pulmonary hemorraghe. Previous or recurrent bleeding can thus be distinguished from fresh events. A differentiation into local or diffuse is of importance. Also differentiate if pulmonary hemorrhage is due to a primary lung disorder or a manifestation of a systemic disease.

name: Abnormality of fibrinolysis
definition: Clinical phenotype characterized by delayed bleeding accelerated break down of blood clot (fibrinolysis)
comments: requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Decrease in high molecular weight von Willebrand factor Multimers
definition: A decrease in high molecular weight von Willebrand factor multimers.
comments: Requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium.

name: Decreased level of heparin co-factor II
definition: An abnormality of coagulation related to a decreased concentration of heparin co-factor II
comments: Requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Decreased level of histidine-rich glycoprotein
definition: Decrease of these levels result in increased inhibition of fibrinolysis and reduced inhibition of coagulation
comments: Requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Decreased circulating plasminogen concentration
definition: The concentration of plasminogen in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
comments: Requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Decreased level of thrombomodulin
definition: Thrombomodulin is a cofactor in the thrombin induced activation of Protein C. In the case of deficiency there will be less Protein C and tendency to clot
comments: Requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Decreased level of tissue plasminogen activator
definition: The tPA protein catalyzes the conversion of plasiminogen to plasmin, and thus break down of clots. When there is a deficiency there will be an increase of thrombosis
comments: Requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Delayed onset bleeding
definition: Abnormal bleeding related to a procedure or trauma which does not start at the time of the initial insult, but after delay by at least 24 hours.

name: Factor XIII subunit A deficiency
definition: Deficiency of factor XIII subunit A, leading to a reduced factor XIII activity. Activated Factor XIII cross-links fibrin polymers solidifying the clot.
comments: Measurement of subunit A or B can be performed by Elisa kits. Adding the more granular term would facilitate mutation analysis as both subunits are encoded by different genes. This is not always performed in the diagnostic workup so 'Reduced factor XIII activity' would sufice. This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Factor XIII subunit B deficiency
definition: Deficiency of factor XIII subunit B, leading to a reduced factor XIII activity. Activated Factor XIII cross-links fibrin polymers solidifying the clot.
comments: Measurement of subunit A or B can be performed by Elisa kits. Adding the more granular term would facilitate mutation analysis as both subunits are encoded by different genes. This is not always performed in the diagnostic workup so 'Reduced factor XIII activity' would sufice. This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Leukocyte inclusion bodies
definition: The presence of intraceullar inclusion bodies (aggregates of stainable substances, usually proteins) in leukocytes.
comments: This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Hyperfibrinolysis
definition: Increased degradation of fibrin, associated with clot instability and bleeding
comments: This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Impaired binding of factor VIII to VWF
definition: Impaired binding of factor VIII to von Willebrand Factor. This is determined using a modified ELISA assay.

synonyms.text: von Willebrand Disease Type II Normandy

comments: This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Impaired neutrophil chemotaxis
definition: An impairment of the migration of neutrophils towards chemoattractants as part of the innate immune response
comments: This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Increased plasma vitamin K epoxide after vitamin K supplementation
definition: Increased plasma vitamin K epoxide after vitamin K supplementation is present in VKCFD (vitamin K-dependent clotting factor deficiency) type 2, but not in VKCFD type 1.
comments: This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Increased ratio of VWF propeptide to VWF antigen
definition: An increased VWF propeptide to VWF antigen indicates that deficiency of VWF is not due to impaired synthesis but due to rapid clearance. The VWF propeptide is measured by ELISA.
comments: Some forms of von Willebrand Disease Type I (particularly those previously classified as type IC) and Acquired von Willebrand Disease. This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Increased RIPA
definition: Increased platelet agglutination in response to low-dose ristocetin
comments: Characteristic of type 2B von Willebrand Disease or platelet-type (pseudo) VWD. (NB: this is not the same as enhanced ristocetin coafactor assay activity) This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Muscle hemorrhage
definition: Bleeding occurring within a muscle

name: Prolonged euglobulin clot lysis time
definition: Abnormally increased length of time required for an in vitro clot to dissolve in the absence of the normal plasmin inhibitors. This test is a clinical assay used to measure fibrinolysis. The euglobulin fraction of plasma is precipitated and used to form clot by addition of thrombin; after clot forms the rate of clot breakdown (fibrinolysis) can be monitored.
comments: This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Prolonged Russell's viper venom time
definition: Increased time to coagulation in the Russell's viper venom assay
comments: This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Reduced alpha-2-antiplasmin activity
definition: Reduced activity of alpha-2-antiplasmin. This protein inactivates the protease plasmin that drives fibrinolysis.
comments: This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Reduced antithrombin antigen
definition: Reduced antithrombin antigen. A reduced level of antithrombin may lead to an increased risk of thrombus formation.
comments: This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Reduced euglobulin clot lysis time
definition: Abnormally decreased length of time required for an in vitro clot to dissolve in the absence of the normal plasmin inhibitors. This test is a clinical assay used to measure fibrinolysis. The euglobulin fraction of plasma is precipitated and used to form clot by addition of thrombin; after clot forms the rate of clot breakdown (fibrinolysis) can be monitored.
comments: This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Reduced plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 activity
definition: Reduced activity of plasminogen activator inhibitor 1. This protein down-regulates fibrinolysis in the circulation by inhibiting the two major plasminogen activators: tissue-plasminogen activator and urokinase-plasminogen activator.
comments: This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Reduced plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 antigen
definition: Reduced level of plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 antigen.
comments: Added the antigen level as diagnosis with only activity levels is very difficult due to assay problems. Activity levels of control patients also include 0 within the normal limit. This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Reduced prothrombin antigen
definition: Reduced prothrombin antigen as measured by ELISA assay. Prothrombin is a vitamin K-dependent coagulation factor that is proteolytically cleaved to form thrombin.
comments: This term has been requested and created by members of the BRIDGE consortium

name: Hand dimple
definition: A cutaneous indentation resulting from tethering of the skin to underlying structures (bone) of the hand.
comments: Use case: PMC4498842

name: Aplastic/Hypoplastic nasopharyngeal adenoids
definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the nasopharyngeal adenoids.

name: Abnormal size of nasopharyngeal adenoids
definition: A deviation in the size of nasopharyngeal adenoids.

name: Hypoplastic nasopharyngeal adenoids
definition: Underdevelopment of the nasopharyngeal adenoids.

name: Aplastic nasopharyngeal adenoids
definition: Absence of the nasopharyngeal adenoids as a developmental defect.

name: Decreased size of nasopharyngeal adenoids
definition: An abnormal decrease in the size of nasopharyngeal adenoids.

name: Increased size of nasopharyngeal adenoids
definition: An abnormal increase in the size of nasopharyngeal adenoids.

name: Glue ear
definition: Middle ear is filled with glue-like fluid instead of air.
comments: In some contexts, glue ear is used interchangeably with otitis media with effusion (OME) (PMID:21653931). Some authors use glue ear to refer to a subtype of OME characterized by thick, glue-like fluid buildup in the middle ear (mucoid otitis media) (PMID:10993548). Serous otitis media is usually responsive to medical treatment, whereas mucoid otitis media is not. This term refers to the mucoid subtype.

name: Jaw pain
definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the jaw.

name: Upper limb muscle hypertrophy
definition: Abnormal increase in muscle size and mass of one or both arms not due to training.

name: obsolete Recurrent infections of the middle ear
Impaired glucose tolerance
definition: An abnormal resistance to glucose, i.e., a reduction in the ability to maintain glucose levels in the blood stream within normal limits following oral or intravenous administration of glucose.

name: Hyperintensity of MRI T2 signal of the spinal cord
definition: A region of high intensity (brightness) observed upon magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans of the spinal cord.
comments: Seen in a wide-ranging variety of spinal cord processes including; simple MR artifacts, congenital anomalies etc. Characterization of the abnormal areas of T2 signal as well as their appearance on other MR imaging sequences, when combined with clinical context and laboratory investigations, will often allow a unique diagnosis, or at least aid in narrowing the differential diagnosis. {xref="PMID:19527360"}

name: Adenocarcinoma of the intestines
definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the intestines.

name: Adenocarcinoma of the small intestine
definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the small intestine.

name: Adenocarcinoma of the large intestine
definition: A malignant epithelial tumor with a glandular organization that originates in the large intestine.

name: Frequency
definition: Class to represent frequency of phenotypic abnormalities within a patient cohort.
comments: Aligned with Orphanet

name: Obligate
definition: Always present, i.e. in 100% of the cases.

name: Very frequent
definition: Present in 80% to 99% of the cases.

name: Frequent
definition: Present in 30% to 79% of the cases.

name: Occasional
definition: Present in 5% to 29% of the cases.

name: Very rare
definition: Present in 1% to 4% of the cases.

name: Excluded
definition: Present in 0% of the cases.

name: Abnormal axial muscle morphology
definition: A structural anomaly of the axial musculature, comprising muscles of the head and neck, muscles of the vertebral column, muscles of the thoracic wall, muscles of the abdominal wall, and muscles of the pelvic floor.

name: Nasogastric tube feeding
definition: The condition of inability to eat normally treated by placement of a thin tube through the nose into the stomach that is then used to carry food.

name: Cyclically decreased total neutrophil count
definition: Abnormal decrease of the absolute number of neutrophils in the blood, per microlitre, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group, which occurs cyclically and then recovers without intervention.

name: Abnormal location of the eyebrow
definition: Anomalous anatomical placement of the eyebrow.

name: Preauricular cyst
definition: Preauricular sinus is an occasional finding and most frequently appears as a small pit close to the anterior margin of the ascending portion of the helix. The opening has also been reported along the postero superior margin of the helix, the tragus or the lobule. Preauricular sinus may lead to the formation of a subcutaneous cyst that is intimately related to the tragal cartilage and the anterior crus of the helix.

name: Decreased circulating free fatty acid level
Abnormal circulating free fatty acid concentration
definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a free fatty acid in the blood circulation.

synonyms.text: Abnormal circulating free fatty acid level

name: Increased urinary glycerol
definition: An increased concentration of glycerol in the urine.

name: Elevated circulating glycerol concentration
definition: The concentration of glycerol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
comments: In glycerol kinase deficiency, the increased glycerol concentration has been noted to cause false-positive results of hypertriglyceridemia, a phenomenon called pseudohypertriglyceridemia.

name: Decreased circulating iron concentration
definition: The concentration of iron cation in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

synonyms.text: Decreased iron cation level in blood
Reduced iron cation level in blood

name: Increased male libido
definition: Increased desire for sexual activity on the part of a male.

name: Decreased male libido
definition: Reduced desire for sexual activity on the part of a male.

name: Male sexual dysfunction
definition: A problem occurring during any phase of the male sexual response cycle that prevents the individual from experiencing satisfaction from the sexual activity

name: Male anorgasmia
definition: Inability of a male to reach orgasm.

name: Sterile arthritis
definition: An inflammatory arthritis characterized by purulent synovial fluid with neutrophil accumulation, but with negative cultures.
comments: This form of arthritis is termed 'sterile' because bacetriology returns negative results even though the clinical presentation resembles that of infectious arthritis.

name: Symmetric polyarthritis
definition: Polyarthritis refers to a joint disease that involves at least five joints. One or more signs of inflammation, including pain, movement restriction, swelling, warmth, and redness, are seen in the joints involved. Polyarthritis is defined as symmetric if at least half of the joints involved are affected in a symmetric (i.e., both right and the left) fashion.
comments: In the event that pain is the only symptom, it is difficult to differentiate polyarthritis from the causes of polyarticular joint pain, such as fibromyalgia or osteoarthritis.

name: Oligoarthritis
definition: A type of arthritis that affects up to four joints in the first six months of disease.

name: Blind vagina
definition: The vagina ends in a blind pouch or sac rather than being connected to the internal genitalia.

name: Tongue edema
definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid and swelling in the tongue.

name: Blue urine
definition: An abnormal blue color of the urine.
comments: Blue or green urine coloration may be observed due to certain dyes used for tests of kidney and bladder function, some medications, and disorders including familial benign hypercalcemia and urinary tract infections caused by pseudomonas bacteria.

name: Red urine
definition: An abnormal red color of the urine.
comments: http://www.health.harvard.edu/newsletter_article/red-brown-green-urine-colors-and-what-they-might-mean

name: Dark urine
definition: An abnormal dark color of the urine.
comments: http://www.health.harvard.edu/newsletter_article/red-brown-green-urine-colors-and-what-they-might-mean

name: Red-brown urine
definition: An abnormal red-brown color of the urine.
comments: http://www.health.harvard.edu/newsletter_article/red-brown-green-urine-colors-and-what-they-might-mean

name: Dark yellow urine
definition: An abnormal dark-yellow color of the urine.
comments: http://www.health.harvard.edu/newsletter_article/red-brown-green-urine-colors-and-what-they-might-mean

name: Purple urine
definition: An abnormal purple color of the urine.
comments: http://www.health.harvard.edu/newsletter_article/red-brown-green-urine-colors-and-what-they-might-mean

name: Eyelid erythema
definition: Redness of the skin of the eyelids, caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin.

name: Heliotrope rash
definition: In a heliotrope rash, the color of the skin turns to violet, which is the color of the heliotrope flower.
comments: Heliotrope rash occurs during the initial phase of the idiopathic inflammatory myositis (particularly dermatomyositis). Heliotrope rash is a characteristic symptom of Dermatomyositis.

name: Bull's eye rash
definition: A cutaneous eruption that consists of multiple (at least two) concentric erythematous rings.

name: Hypoplasia of the olfactory bulb
definition: Underdevelopment of the olfactory bulb.

name: Abnormal morphology of the olfactory bulb
definition: An abnormal morphology of the olfactory bulb (bulbus olfactorius), which is involved in olfaction, i.e. the sense of smell.

name: Focal hyperintensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
definition: An abnormal area of increased brightness (hyperintensity) that is limited to one particular area.

name: Multifocal hyperintensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
definition: An abnormal area of increased brightness (hyperintensity) that occurs in several distinct areas.

name: Confluent hyperintensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
definition: Areas of brighter than expected MRI signal in the white matter of the brain whereby individual patches run together.

name: Focal hypointensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
Multifocal hypointensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
Confluent hypointensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
Purulent rhinitis
definition: Chronic rhinitis accompanied by pus formation.
comments: An infection of the nasal mucosa associated with pus formation. (Often secondary to a systemic infection, such as measles)

name: Nipple localization
definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is distributed around the nipples or located in the nipples.

name: Breast microcalcification
definition: The term breast microcalcification is used to define calcium deposits in the breast with a diameter of less than 1 mm.

name: Architectural distortion of breast
definition: Architectural distortion is defined as an architectural disruption of the normal breast that does not have obvious mass opacities, which may be early signs of breast carcinoma.

name: Asymmetric thickening of the nipple-areolar complex
definition: Thickening of the skin around the nipple with a distribution that is not equal on all sides.

name: Perimenopausal
definition: Perimenopause, or the menopausal transition, encompasses that period of time during which physiologic changes mark progression toward a woman's final menstrual period. This phase begins with the onset of menstrual irregularities and continues until a woman reaches menopause, or one year after amenorrhea has occurred. Perimenopause can last for a variable amount of time, the median of which is four years.

name: Mastitis
definition: Mastitis is defined as an inflammation of the breast and may or may not be accompanied by infection.

name: Ameliorated by menopause
definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by menopause.
comments: This term may apply to breast fibroadenoma and premenstrual dysphoric disorder.

name: Fluctuance on palpation
definition: Yielding to alternate pressure by palpating fingers so as to suggest that the area being felt contains fluid.

name: History of vasectomy
definition: A medical history of having undergone a vasectomy prior to the current presentation.

name: Pain in penis
definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the penis.

name: Left ventricular thrombus
definition: A blood clot (thrombus) localized in the left ventricle. Left ventricular thrombus is a serious complication of acute myocardial infarction and also of non-ischemic cardiomyopathies.

name: Gelatinous ascites
definition: A type of ascites characterized by copious amounts of mucinous ascites and mucinous peritoneal implants, leading to progressive obliteration of the peritoneal cavity and intestinal obstruction.
comments: See figures 2 and 3 of PMID:28868432.

name: Diffuse breast nodularity
definition: Breast tissue with a lumpy or ropelike texture.

name: Abnormal urinary nitrogen compound level
definition: The amount of a nitrogen compound in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside of normal limits.

name: Decreased urinary biopterin level
definition: The amount of biopterin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Abnormal urine guanidinoacetic acid level
definition: The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside normal limits.

name: Elevated urine guanidinoacetic acid level
definition: The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Decreased urinary neopterin level
definition: The amount of neopterin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Abnormal urinary inosine level
definition: The amount of inosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.

name: Elevated urinary inosine level
definition: The amount of inosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Abnormal urinary guanosine level
definition: The amount of guanosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.

name: Elevated urinary guanosine level
definition: The amount of guanosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Abnormal urinary hypoxanthine level
definition: The concentration of hypoxanthine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is outside of normal limits.

name: Decreased urinary hypoxanthine level
definition: The concentration of hypoxanthine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Absent neutrophil lactoferrin
definition: The absence of lactoferrin in neutrophil granules, which could be caused by either an isolated failure of synthesis of this protein (or the production of an antigenically unrecognizable form of lactoferrin) or a complete deficiency of specific granule production.

name: Neutrophil nuclear clefts
definition: An abnormality of the nucleus of neutrophils, which presents as either a type I nuclear cleft, where the nuclear cleft may show a transition into a round/oval shape. The second type nuclear cleft, which runs perpendicular to the nuclear surface, and this type of cleft might be related to nuclear lobe formation.

name: Low neutrophil alkaline phosphatase
definition: An abnormally reduced level of alkaline phosphatase in neutrophils, which could be due to absence of enzyme or the production of defective enzyme.

name: Increased neutrophil mitochondria
definition: An increased number of mitochondria detected in neutrophils.

name: Increased neutrophil ribosomes
definition: An increased number of ribosomes detected in neutrophils.

name: Bladder outlet obstruction
definition: A compression or resistance upon the bladder outflow channel at any location from the bladder neck to urethral meatus, which usually causes lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS).

name: Decreased expression of GPI-anchored proteins on the cell surface
definition: A decrease in the protein expression of GPI-anchor proteins, such as CD55 and CD59, at the cell surface, which suggests a defect in GPI-anchor biosynthesis.

name: Starch intolerance
definition: An inability to digest starch.

name: Renal tubular cyst
definition: Tubular lumnal dilatation/prominence lined by simple layer of cuboidal-to-flat tublar epihelial cells.

name: Ageusia
definition: A rare condition that is characterized by a complete loss of taste function of the tongue.

name: Agenesis of putamen
definition: A developmental defect characterized by the absence of the putamen owing to its failure to develop.
comments: The basal ganglia are symmetrical subcortical gray nuclei at the core of the extrapyramidal system, composed by the striatum (which comprises the putamen, caudate nucleus, olfactory tubercle, and nucleus accumbens), the pallidum, the substantia nigra, and the subthalamic nucleus. Congenital malformations of the basal ganglia deriving from defects of embryogenesis are very rare. The basal ganglia embryologically derive from the prosencephalon (or forebrain), the most rostral of the three vesicles originating from early patterning of the neural tube along the anterior-posterior axis.

name: obsolete Fractured thoracic segment of trunk
Fractured humerus
definition: A partial or complete breakage of the humerus.

name: Hot cross bun sign
definition: A cruciform-shaped hyperintensity within the pons found on T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).
comments: It is commonly associated with atrophy of the pons, cerebellum, and putamen in multiple system atrophy (MSA). See figure 15 in PMID:29089832.

name: Transient decreased circulating IgG4 concentration
definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) in the blood circulation.

name: Chronic decreased circulating IgG4 concentration
definition: A lasting decrease of immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) in the blood.

name: Chronic absent circulating IgG4
definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgG4 can be measured.

Fractured calcaneus
definition: A partial or complete breakage of the calcaneus.

name: Chronic decreased circulating IgG2 concentration
definition: A lasting decrease of immunoglobulin G2 (IgG2) in the blood.

definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin G2 (IgG2) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgG2 can be measured.

definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) in the blood circulation.

name: Chronic decreased circulating IgG1 concentration

name: Chronic absent circulating IgG1
definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgG1 can be measured.
