definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious keratitis, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the cornea, or by keratitis caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
comments: Principal causative agents in the context of immune deficiency include herpes simplex virus (HSV stromal keratitis, with a recurrence rate of 50% in immunodeficient patients) and varicella-zoster virus (herpes zoster ophthalmicus with corneal involvement). Immunodeficiency is a significant independent risk factor for recurrent HSV keratitis.

name: Severe keratitis
definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious keratitis, as manifested by a severe episode of corneal infection with stromal involvement, corneal ulceration, perforation, or significant visual impairment.

name: Recurrent keratitis
definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious keratitis, as manifested by recurrent episodes of corneal infection that are unusual in frequency for a healthy individual of the same age.
comments: Recurrent HSV keratitis is a hallmark of T-cell immunodeficiency and is associated with progressive corneal scarring and visual loss.

name: Unusual retinitis
definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious retinitis, as manifested by recurrent or severe infection of the retina, or by retinitis caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
comments: The principal causative agent in the context of immune deficiency is cytomegalovirus (CMV retinitis), which is a hallmark of severe T-cell deficiency and combined immunodeficiency. Other agents include VZV (acute retinal necrosis) and HSV.

name: Severe retinitis
definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious retinitis, as manifested by severe or extensive retinal infection with rapid progression, retinal detachment, or significant visual loss.

name: Recurrent retinitis
definition: Increased susceptibility to infectious retinitis, as manifested by recurrent episodes of retinal infection that are unusual in frequency for a healthy individual of the same age.

name: Family history of unusual infection
definition: A family history (in a first- or second-degree relative) of unusually severe, recurrent, or opportunistic infection.

name: Family history of immune deficiency
definition: A family history (in a first- or second-degree relative) of an immune deficiency.

synonyms.text: Familiy history of primary immunodeficiency disorders (PID)
Family history of an inborn error of imunity (IEI)

name: Family history of autoimmunity
definition: A family history (in a first- or second-degree relative) of an autoimmune disease.

name: Family history of death due to infection
definition: A family history of death of a first- or second-degree relative caused by infection.

name: Family history of lymphoma
definition: A family history (in a first- or second-degree relative) of a lymphoma.
comments: A family history of lymphoma may indicate inherited cancer predisposition syndromes, including DNA repair defects, and inborn errors of immunity predisposing to lymphoproliferative disease such as X-linked lymphoproliferative syndrome and ITK deficiency.

name: Family history of leukaemia
definition: A family history (in a first- or second-degree relative) of a leukaemia.
comments: A family history of leukaemia may indicate inherited bone marrow failure syndromes, DNA repair defects, or inborn errors of immunity predisposing to malignancy, including GATA2 deficiency, SAMD9/SAMD9L disorders, and Fanconi anaemia.

name: Maternal history of recurrent miscarriage
definition: A maternal history of recurrent miscarriage, defined as two or more pregnancy losses.

synonyms.text: Maternal history of recurrent spontaneous abortion

name: Unexplained sibling death
definition: Death of a sibling that remains unexplained despite investigation, which may indicate an undiagnosed disease in the family.

name: Consanguinity
definition: A reproductive relationship between two individuals who are related by blood as second cousins or closer. In a medical and genetic context, consanguinity increases the coefficient of inbreeding, raising the probability that an offspring will inherit identical alleles from a common ancestor (homozygosity by descent). This significantly increases the risk for autosomal recessive disorders, such as inborn errors of immunity, metabolic diseases, and rare neurodevelopmental syndromes. A history of consanguinity serves as a vital clinical marker for directing diagnostic investigations toward recessive genetic etiologies, especially in the presence of rare phenotypes or unexplained family medical history.

name: Unusual mycobacterial osteomyelitis
definition: An osteomyelitis caused by mycobacterial infection, with causative organisms including Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Mycobacterium bovis BCG (typically as a complication of BCG vaccination), and non-tuberculous mycobacteria.
comments: A mycobacterial osteomyelitis can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in Mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial disease (MSMD) and combined immunodeficiency.

name: Unusual musculoskeletal infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to infection of bones, joints, or muscles, as manifested by recurrent or severe osteomyelitis, septic arthritis, or infectious myositis, or by musculoskeletal infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
comments: Recurrent musculoskeletal infections are characteristic of phagocyte defects, sickle cell-related asplenia, and combined immunodeficiencies.

name: Unusual infectious osteomyelitis
definition: Increased susceptibility to osteomyelitis of infectious aetiology, as manifested by recurrent or severe bone infection, multifocal osteomyelitis, or osteomyelitis caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.
comments: Recurrent or multifocal osteomyelitis is a characteristic manifestation of various diseases, such as chronic granulomatous disease, phagocyte defects, innate signaling defects (such as MyD88 or IRAK4 deficiency), IFN-gamma pathway defects, and humoral immunodeficiencies (such as XLA).

name: Unusual lymphatic system infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to infection involving lymph nodes or lymphatic vessels, as manifested by recurrent or severe lymphadenitis or lymph node abscess, or by lymphatic infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism.

name: Unusual oral cavity infection
definition: Infection of the oral cavity including the gingiva, periodontium, teeth, tongue, or oral mucosa that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.

name: Post-vaccination mumps
definition: Infection with attenuated mumps vaccine virus following mumps vaccination, occurring in the context of unusual susceptibility to live viral vaccines.

name: Cytomegalovirus retinitis
definition: Retinitis caused by cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: CMV retinitis is an atypical manifestation of cytomegalovirus, most commonly encountered as an opportunistic infection in immunocompromised hosts.

name: Cytomegalovirus pneumonitis
definition: Pneumonitis caused by cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: CMV pneumonitis is an atypical manifestation of cytomegalovirus, most commonly encountered as an opportunistic infection in immunocompromised hosts.

name: Cytomegalovirus encephalitis
definition: Encephalitis caused by cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: CMV encephalitis is an atypical manifestation of cytomegalovirus, most commonly encountered as an opportunistic infection in immunocompromised hosts.

name: Unusual EBV infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) infections as manifested by severe or disseminated disease or impaired control of EBV infection.

name: EBV-driven HLH
definition: Haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) triggered by Epstein-Barr virus infection.

name: Disseminated herpes simplex virus infection
definition: Disseminated infection with herpes simplex virus (HSV), involving multiple organ systems.

name: Recurrent herpes simplex virus infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to herpes simplex virus (HSV) infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of HSV infection.

name: Persistent adenovirus viremia
definition: Persistent or recurrent detection of adenovirus in the blood that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: Persistent adenoviral viraemia is characteristic of T-cell deficiencies, severe combined immunodeficiency, and post-transplant immunosuppression, and may progress to disseminated adenoviral disease.

name: Adenovirus colitis
definition: Colitis caused by adenovirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: Adenoviral colitis is an opportunistic gastrointestinal manifestation characteristic of T-cell deficiencies and immunocompromised hosts, presenting with prolonged or severe diarrhoea, dehydration, and intestinal mucosal injury.

name: Adenovirus hepatitis
definition: Hepatitis caused by adenovirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: Adenoviral hepatitis is an opportunistic manifestation seen in T-cell deficiencies and post-transplant patients, and may present with elevated transaminases, coagulopathy, or fulminant hepatic failure.

name: Adenovirus encephalitis
definition: Encephalitis caused by adenovirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: Adenoviral encephalitis is a rare but severe opportunistic manifestation typically seen in severe T-cell deficiencies and immunocompromised hosts, presenting with seizures, focal neurological deficits, or altered consciousness.

name: Adenovirus pneumonitis
definition: Pneumonitis caused by adenovirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: Adenoviral pneumonitis is an opportunistic manifestation characteristic of T-cell deficiencies and stem cell transplant recipients, often presenting with severe hypoxia, diffuse pulmonary infiltrates, and respiratory failure.

name: Recurrent chickenpox infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to varicella (chickenpox) infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of chickenpox infection.

name: Severe chickenpox infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to varicella (chickenpox) infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with varicella (chickenpox).

name: VZV encephalitis
definition: Encephalitis caused by varicella-zoster virus (VZV) infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: VZV encephalitis is an opportunistic CNS manifestation characteristic of T-cell deficiencies and may also occur as a complication of severe primary varicella or zoster reactivation, presenting with altered consciousness, seizures, or focal neurological deficits.

name: VZV pneumonitis
definition: Pneumonitis caused by varicella-zoster virus (VZV) infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: VZV pneumonitis is a severe complication of primary varicella or disseminated zoster, characteristic of T-cell deficiencies and immunosuppressed hosts, and may present with hypoxia, diffuse pulmonary nodular infiltrates, and respiratory failure.

name: Unusual warts
definition: Increased susceptibility to human papillomavirus (HPV) causing warts infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with HPV causing warts, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Disseminated warts
definition: Increased susceptibility to human papillomavirus (HPV) manifested by unusually severe, extensive, or invasive warts.

name: Recurrent warts
definition: Increased susceptibility to human papillomavirus (HPV), manifested by recurrent episodes of warts.

name: Chronic warts
definition: Increased susceptibility to chronic or persistent human papillomavirus (HPV) infection causing warts that fail to clear over an extended period or recur after treatment that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: Chronic warts are characteristic of T-cell deficiencies (DOCK8, GATA2), WHIM syndrome (CXCR4), and epidermodysplasia verruciformis (EVER1, EVER2, CIB1).

name: Persistent molluscum infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to Molluscum contagiosum infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of Molluscum contagiosum infection.

name: Unusual norovirus infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to norovirus infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with norovirus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Chronic norovirus infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to chronic or persistent norovirus infection, as manifested by prolonged viral shedding and recurrent or unremitting gastrointestinal symptoms beyond the typical course of acute infection.
comments: Chronic norovirus infection is characteristic of antibody deficiencies (CVID, X-linked agammaglobulinaemia) and combined immunodeficiencies, and may cause persistent diarrhoea, malabsorption, and failure to thrive.

name: Unusual Aichi virus hepatitis
definition: Hepatitis caused by Aichi virus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: Aichi virus hepatitis has been described as a rare opportunistic manifestation in patients with primary antibody deficiencies and severe combined immunodeficiency, and represents a clinically distinct gastrointestinal/hepatic viral infection in IEI.

name: Unusual enterovirus infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to enterovirus infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with enterovirus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Enteroviral central nervous system infection
definition: Infection of the central nervous system by enterovirus that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: Enteroviral CNS infection, including chronic enteroviral meningoencephalitis, is a hallmark of X-linked agammaglobulinaemia and other antibody deficiencies, and may present with progressive neurological deterioration, dermatomyositis-like syndrome, or fatal meningoencephalitis.

name: Enteroviral sepsis
definition: Sepsis or sepsis-like syndrome caused by enterovirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: Enteroviral sepsis is a severe systemic manifestation typically seen in neonates, patients with antibody deficiencies, or immunocompromised hosts, presenting with multi-organ involvement, haemodynamic instability, and high mortality.

name: Unusual astrovirus infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to astrovirus infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with astrovirus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Disseminated astrovirus infection
definition: Disseminated infection with astrovirus involving organs beyond the gastrointestinal tract that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: Disseminated astrovirus infection is a rare opportunistic manifestation described primarily in severe combined immunodeficiency and post-transplant patients, and may present with viraemia, encephalitis, or multi-organ involvement.

name: Astrovirus central nervous system infection
definition: Infection of the central nervous system by astrovirus that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: Astroviral CNS infection, typically presenting as encephalitis or meningoencephalitis, has been described as a rare but recognised manifestation in patients with severe combined immunodeficiency and primary antibody deficiencies.

name: Unusual influenza infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to influenza virus infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with influenza virus.

name: Persitent influenza viremia
definition: Persistent or recurrent detection of influenza virus in the blood or prolonged shedding in respiratory secretions that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.
comments: Persistent influenza infection is characteristic of T-cell deficiencies and immunocompromised hosts, and may be associated with prolonged respiratory illness, antiviral resistance, and severe lower respiratory tract complications.

name: Unusual parainfluenza infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to parainfluenza virus infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with parainfluenza virus.

name: Recurrent parainfluenza virus infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to parainfluenza virus infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of parainfluenza virus infection.

name: Chronic SARS-CoV-2 infection
definition: A persistent SARS-CoV-2 infection with prolonged active viral replication and continuous detection of virus beyond the typical duration of acute COVID-19, typically lasting several weeks or longer, often with culturable virus and intra-host viral evolution. A chronic COVID-19 infection is distinct from post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (long COVID), which represents a post-infectious syndrome after viral clearance, and from recurrent COVID-19 reinfections, which are common in the general population.
comments: A chronic COVID-19 infection can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in B-cell-depleted patients (following rituximab, anti-CD20 therapy, CAR-T cell therapy, or hematopoietic stem cell transplantation), antibody deficiencies, and combined immunodeficiencies.

name: Severe seasonal coronavirus infection
definition: A severe infection caused by a seasonal coronavirus (HCoV-229E, HCoV-OC43, HCoV-NL63, or HCoV-HKU1), characterized by lower respiratory tract involvement, hypoxia, or systemic illness beyond that typically seen with these viruses in immunocompetent hosts.
comments: A severe seasonal coronavirus infection can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in T-cell deficiencies and post-hematopoietic-stem-cell-transplant patients.

name: Chronic seasonal coronavirus infection
definition: A persistent infection with a seasonal coronavirus (HCoV-229E, HCoV-OC43, HCoV-NL63, or HCoV-HKU1) with prolonged active viral replication beyond the typical duration of acute infection.
comments: A chronic seasonal coronavirus infection can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in antibody deficiencies and combined immunodeficiencies.

name: Unusual HHV6 infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to human herpesvirus 6 (HHV-6) infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with HHV-6, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location, such as the brain.

name: Unusual HHV8 infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to human herpesvirus 8 (HHV-8) infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with HHV-8, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.
comments: Unusual or severe HHV-8 infections, including Kaposi sarcoma, are primarily associated with severe T-cell deficiencies (both primary and secondary) and CD4 T-cell lymphopenia. This phenotype has also been specifically described in cases of Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome.

name: BK virus nephropathy
definition: Nephropathy caused by BK polyomavirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.

synonyms.text: Nephropathy caused by a Human polyomavirus 1 infection

comments: BK virus nephropathy is an opportunistic manifestation characteristic of solid organ transplant recipients (particularly renal transplant) and hematopoietic stem cell transplant patients, presenting with progressive renal dysfunction and tubulointerstitial nephritis.

name: BK virus encephalitis
definition: Encephalitis caused by BK polyomavirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.

synonyms.text: Encephalitis caused by a Human polyomavirus 1 infection

comments: BK virus encephalitis is a rare opportunistic CNS manifestation typically seen in severe T-cell deficiencies and post-transplant patients. It may also present as Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML), involving either BK or JC polyomavirus, and has been specifically described in cases of Hyper-IgM syndrome and DOCK8 deficiency. Clinical presentations often include altered consciousness, seizures, or focal neurological deficits.

name: Unusual JC virus infection
definition: Increased susceptibility to JC polyomavirus infections as manifested by recurrent or severe/invasive infection with JC polyomavirus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: JC nephropathy
definition: Nephropathy caused by JC polyomavirus infection that occurs in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.

synonyms.text: Nephropathy caused by a Human polyomavirus 2 infection

comments: JC virus nephropathy is a rare opportunistic manifestation described in T-cell deficiencies and post-transplant patients, presenting with progressive renal dysfunction and tubulointerstitial inflammation.

name: JC encephalitis
definition: Encephalitis caused by JC polyomavirus infection, typically presenting as progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML).

synonyms.text: Encephalitis caused by a Human polyomavirus 2 infection

comments: JC virus encephalitis is an opportunistic CNS infection typically seen in severe T-cell deficiencies and post-transplant patients. It often presents as Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) and has been specifically described in DOCK8 deficiency and Hyper-IgM syndrome. Clinical manifestations typically include progressive neurological deficits, cognitive impairment, and ataxia.

name: Infectious granulomatosis
definition: Granulomatous inflammation with multiple granuloma formation attributable to a causative infectious agent, including bacteria, mycobacteria, fungi, or parasites.

name: Non-infectious granulomatosis
definition: Granulomatous inflammation involving the formation of multiple granulomas not attributable to a causative infectious agent, arising in the context of immune dysregulation, foreign-body reactions or idiopathic.

name: Caseating granulomatosis
definition: Granulomatous inflammation characterized by the formation of multiple granulomas exhibiting caseation necrosis, in which the necrotic tissue acquires an amorphous, cheese-like appearance.

name: Non-caseating granulomatosis
definition: Granulomatous inflammation characterized by the formation of multiple granulomas without central caseation necrosis.

name: Granulomatous lymphocytic interstitial lung disease
definition: An interstitial lung disease, characterized by lymphocytic infiltration and/or granulomatous inflammation of the lung after exclusion of infection and alternative causes, often associated with multisystem inflammatory or granulomatous disease in patients with common variable immunodeficiency (CVID).

name: Granulomatous lymphadenopathy
definition: Lymph node enlargement resulting from granulomatous inflammation, characterized by compact aggregates of epithelioid macrophages and giant cells within the lymph node parenchyma.

name: Granuloma annulare
definition: A non-infectious inflammatory granulomatous dermatosis characterized by annular or disseminated erythematous plaques resulting from palisading granulomas with central mucin deposition in the dermis.

name: Granulomatous synovitis
definition: Inflammation of the synovial membrane characterized by granuloma formation within synovial tissue, consisting of aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes with or without multinucleated giant cells.

name: Granulomatous uveitis
definition: Uveitis characterized by granulomatous inflammatory pattern of the uveal tract, with clinical findings that may include large keratic precipitates, iris nodules, or other signs of intraocular granulomatous inflammation.

name: Granulomatous gingivitis
definition: Inflammation of the gingiva characterized by granulomatous tissue reaction, with compact aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes and multinucleate giant cells within the gingival lamina propria.

name: Granulomatous iritis
definition: Inflammation of the iris characterized by granulomatous tissue reaction, with compact aggregates of mononuclear phagocytes within the iris stroma.

name: Unusual Burkholderia pseudomallei infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Burkholderia pseudomallei infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Burkholderia pseudomallei, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Unusual coagulase-negative Staphylococcus infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to coagulase-negative staphylococci infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with coagulase-negative staphylococci, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Recurrent coagulase-negative Staphylococcus infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to coagulase-negative staphylococci infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of coagulase-negative staphylococci infection.

name: Severe coagulase-negative Staphylococcus infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to coagulase-negative staphylococci infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with coagulase-negative staphylococci.

name: Unusual Enterococcus faecalis infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Enterococcus faecalis infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Enterococcus faecalis, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Recurrent Enterococcus faecalis infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Enterococcus faecalis infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.

name: Severe Enterococcus faecalis infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Enterococcus faecalis infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Enterococcus faecalis.

name: Unusual Enterococcus faecium infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Enterococcus faecium infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Enterococcus faecium, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Recurrent Enterococcus faecium infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Enterococcus faecium infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.

name: Severe Enterococcus faecium infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Enterococcus faecium infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Enterococcus faecium.

name: Unusual Viridans Streptococci infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to viridans group streptococci infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with viridans group streptococci, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Endocarditis caused by Streptococcus viridans infection
definition: An endocarditis caused by infection with viridans group streptococci, which are a characteristic causative agent of subacute bacterial endocarditis.

synonyms.text: Subacute bacterial endocarditis due to viridans streptococci

name: Liver abscess due to Streptococcus viridans
definition: A liver abscess caused by infection with viridans group streptococci, which may arise from hematogenous spread, biliary infection, or contiguous spread.

synonyms.text: Hepatic abscess due to Streptococcus viridans

name: Unusual Mycobacterium abscessus infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycobacterium abscessus infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Mycobacterium abscessus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Recurrent Mycobacterium abscessus infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycobacterium abscessus infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.

name: Severe Mycobacterium abscessus infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycobacterium abscessus infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Mycobacterium abscessus.

name: Unusual Mycobacterium avium complex infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycobacterium avium complex infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Mycobacterium avium complex, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

synonyms.text: Unusual susceptibility to Mycobacterium avium complex

name: Recurrent Mycobacterium avium complex infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycobacterium avium complex infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.

name: Severe Mycobacterium avium complex infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycobacterium avium complex infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Mycobacterium avium complex.

name: Unusual Mycoplasma infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycoplasma infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Mycoplasma, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Recurrent Mycoplasma infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycoplasma infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.

name: Severe Mycoplasma infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Mycoplasma infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Mycoplasma.

name: Unusual Ureaplasma infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Ureaplasma infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Ureaplasma, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Pulmonary cryptococcosis
definition: An infection of the lungs caused by Cryptococcus species, which is the most common entry portal for cryptococcal disease and may present as nodules, consolidation, or interstitial infiltrates.
comments: A pulmonary cryptococcosis can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in severe T-cell deficiencies, idiopathic CD4 lymphopenia, and anti-GM-CSF autoantibody syndromes.

name: Cryptococcoma
definition: A granulomatous mass-like lesion caused by Cryptococcus infection, which may occur in the lung, brain, skin, or other organs.
comments: A cryptococcoma can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in T-cell deficiencies and immunosuppressed hosts.

name: Unusual mucormycosis
definition: An increased susceptibility to Mucorales infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Mucorales, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Unusual Talaromyces marneffei infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Talaromyces marneffei infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Talaromyces marneffei, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Unusual dermatophyte infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to dermatophytes infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with dermatophytes, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Recurrent dermatophyte infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to dermatophytes infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.

name: Increased CD4+ TEMRA T cell proportion
definition: An abnormally increased proportion of CD4-positive TEMRA T cells (terminally differentiated effector memory T cells re-expressing CD45RA), relative to total CD4-positive T cells in the blood. These cells have a CD45RA-positive, CD45RO-negative, CCR7-negative phenotype.

name: Unusual mold infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to mould infection, as manifested by a recurrent or severe invasive infection with filamentous fungi other than Aspergillus, or by a mould infection caused by an atypical or opportunistic organism. Common causative organisms include Fusarium species, Scedosporium species, and Lomentospora prolificans.
comments: An invasive mould infection most often occurs in the context of severe immunocompromise, particularly in prolonged neutropenia and post-hematopoietic-stem-cell-transplant patients.

name: Unusual Blastomyces dermatitidis infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Blastomyces dermatitidis infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Blastomyces dermatitidis, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Recurrent Blastomyces dermatitidis infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Blastomyces dermatitidis infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.

name: Severe Blastomyces dermatitidis infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Blastomyces dermatitidis infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Blastomyces dermatitidis.

name: Unusual Coccidioides infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Coccidioides infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Coccidioides, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Recurrent Coccidioides infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Coccidioides infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.

name: Severe Coccidioides infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Coccidioides infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Coccidioides.

name: Unusual Paracoccidioides brasiliensis infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Paracoccidioides brasiliensis infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Paracoccidioides brasiliensis, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Recurrent Paracoccidioides brasiliensis infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Paracoccidioides brasiliensis infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.

name: Severe Paracoccidioides brasiliensis infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Paracoccidioides brasiliensis infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Paracoccidioides brasiliensis.

name: Recurrent Histoplasma capsulatum infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Histoplasma capsulatum infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection with this pathogen.

name: Unusual Candida auris infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Candida auris infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with Candida auris, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Chronic Candida auris infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to chronic or persistent Candida auris infection, as manifested by prolonged infection with this multi-drug-resistant emerging Candida species.

name: Severe Candida auris infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to Candida auris infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with Candida auris.

name: HSV hepatitis
definition: A hepatitis caused by herpes simplex virus (HSV) infection, which may present as a severe or fulminant hepatitis with elevated transaminases, coagulopathy, and hepatic failure.
comments: An HSV hepatitis can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in T-cell deficiencies, neonates, and immunosuppressed hosts.

name: VZV meningitis
definition: A meningitis caused by varicella-zoster virus (VZV) infection, which may occur as part of primary varicella, herpes zoster, or zoster sine herpete (without rash).
comments: A VZV meningitis can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in T-cell deficiencies and immunosuppressed hosts.

name: Giant molluscum
definition: A molluscum contagiosum lesion exceeding one centimetre in diameter, which may present as an unusually large, persistent, or atypical lesion.
comments: A giant molluscum can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in DOCK8 deficiency, GATA2 deficiency, and severe T-cell deficiencies.

name: Unusual HHV7 infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to human herpesvirus 7 (HHV-7) infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with HHV-7, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: BK virus cystitis
definition: A cystitis caused by BK polyomavirus infection, typically presenting as haemorrhagic cystitis with macroscopic haematuria.
comments: A BK cystitis can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in hematopoietic stem cell transplant recipients and severely immunocompromised hosts.

name: Unusual poliovirus infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to poliovirus infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with poliovirus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Chronic poliovirus excretion
definition: A chronic shedding of poliovirus in stool over an extended period, typically following vaccination with live attenuated oral poliovirus vaccine, with viral excretion persisting for months or years. A chronic poliovirus excretion is characteristic of antibody deficiencies including X-linked agammaglobulinaemia and common variable immunodeficiency, in which patients may shed vaccine-derived poliovirus indefinitely.

name: Severe rotavirus infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to rotavirus infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with rotavirus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Unusual respiratory syncytial virus infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with RSV, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

synonyms.text: Unusual susceptibility to respiratory syncytial virus

name: Severe respiratory syncytial virus infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections as manifested by a severe or invasive infection with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV).

name: Chronic respiratory syncytial virus infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to chronic or persistent respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection, as manifested by prolonged viral shedding and persistent or recurrent respiratory symptoms beyond the typical course of acute infection.

name: Chronic rhinovirus infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to rhinovirus infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with rhinovirus, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Unusual human metapneumovirus infection
definition: An increased susceptibility to human metapneumovirus (hMPV) infections as manifested by a recurrent or severe/invasive infection with hMPV, or occurring in an unusual anatomical location.

name: Toxoplasma eye infection
definition: An ocular infection caused by Toxoplasma gondii, typically presenting as chorioretinitis with characteristic retinal lesions and potential progression to vision loss.
comments: A Toxoplasma eye infection can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in T-cell deficiencies and congenital toxoplasmosis.

name: BCG-associated disease
definition: An adverse disease following vaccination with the Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) live attenuated Mycobacterium bovis vaccine, ranging from local BCGitis (regional lymphadenitis or injection-site abscess) to disseminated BCGosis. BCG associated disease can be a manifestation of unusual susceptibility to infection, particularly in severe combined immunodeficiency, Mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial disease (MSMD), and chronic granulomatous disease.

name: Abnormal effector memory CD4+ T cell proportion
definition: An abnormal proportion of effector memory CD4-positive memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These are memory cells that are short-lived cells that migrate to the site of an infection and attempt to eliminate the pathogen. These cells may have a CD3/CD4/CD62L-/CD45RA phenotype.

name: Abnormal central memory CD4+ T cell proportion
definition: An abnormal proportion of central memory CD4-positive memory T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These cells have the phenotype of CCR7-positive, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.

name: Decreased total T cell number
definition: Abnormal decrease of absolute number (either count per volume or proportion of total lymphocytes) of T cells or of a subset of T cells, commonly characterized as CD3+ lymphocytes, in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These may include both TCR alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cells.

synonyms.text: Decreased numbers of circulating T cells

name: Increased total T cell number
definition: Abnormal increase of absolute number (either count per volume or proportion of total lymphocytes) of T cells or of a subset of T cells, commonly characterized as CD3+ lymphocytes, in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These may include both TCR alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cells.

name: Decreased total T cell proportion
definition: Abnormal decrease in the proportion of T cells, commonly characterized as CD3+ lymphocytes, measured as a percentage of total lymphocytes in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These may include both TCR alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cells.

name: Increased total T cell proportion
definition: Abnormal increase in the proportion of T cells, commonly characterized as CD3+ lymphocytes, measured as a percentage of total lymphocytes in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These may include both TCR alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cells.

name: Decreased total CD4+ T cell number
definition: Abnormal decrease of absolute number of helper CD3+CD4+ T cells (either count per volume or percentage of total lymphocytes), compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.

name: Increased CD4+ T cell number
definition: Abnormal increase of absolute number of helper CD3+CD4+ T cells (either count per volume or percentage of total lymphocytes), compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.

name: Increased total CD4+ T cell count
definition: Abnormal increase of absolute count of helper CD3+CD4+ T cells (quantified as count per volume), compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.

synonyms.text: Increased circulating CD4+ T cell count

name: Decreased total CD4+ T cell count
definition: Abnormal decrease of absolute count of helper CD3+CD4+ T cells (quantified as count per volume), compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.

synonyms.text: Decreased circulating CD4+ T cell count

name: Autoimmune cytopenia
definition: A reduction in one or more peripheral blood cell lineages resulting from immune-mediated destruction or impairment caused by an autoimmune process.

name: Severe eczema
definition: A severe form of eczema characterised by extensive skin involvement and/or persistent or recurrent symptoms requiring intensive treatment.

name: Autoimmune hepatitis
definition: A chronic inflammatory liver disease characterised by immune-mediated hepatocellular injury resulting from an autoimmune process.

name: Non-infectious encephalitis
definition: A disorder of the brain not caused by an infectious agent, characterised by inflammation of the brain parenchyma. It may present with an altered level of consciousness, focal or multifocal neurologic deficits, and seizures; unlike infectious encephalitis, fever is often absent, and autoimmune forms frequently present subacutely with cognitive, psychiatric, or behavioural changes.

name: Autoimmune encephalitis
definition: An inflammation of the brain parenchyma caused by an autoimmune process directed against neuronal or glial antigens.

name: Increased total CD8+ T cell number
definition: Abnormal increase of the absolute number of cytotoxic CD3+CD8+ T cells (measured the absolute count per volume or as percentage of total CD3+ T cells in the blood), compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.

name: Decreased total CD8+ T cell number
definition: Abnormal decrease of the absolute number of cytotoxic CD3+CD8+ T cells (measured the absolute count per volume or as percentage of total CD3+ T cells in the blood), compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.

name: Decreased total CD8+ T cell count
definition: Abnormal decrease of cytotoxic CD3+CD8+ T cells, measured as the total count per volumne in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.

synonyms.text: Decreased circulating CD8+ T cell count

name: Increased total CD8+ T cell count
definition: Abnormal increase of cytotoxic CD3+CD8+ T cells, measured as the total count per volumne in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.

name: HSV pneumonia
definition: Infection of the lung parenchyma with herpes simplex virus, resulting in inflammation of the lung parenchyma with impaired respiratory function.

synonyms.text: Pneumonia due to herpes simplex virus

name: Recurrent Haemophilus influenzae conjunctivitis
definition: Recurrent episodes of conjunctivitis caused by infection with Haemophilus influenzae, characterised by inflammation of the conjunctiva associated with conjunctival injection and purulent ocular discharge.
comments: Recurrent or severe Haemophilus influenzae infections are commonly reported in patients with primary antibody deficiencies and may represent an important clue to an underlying defect in humoral immunity.

name: Hindfoot deformity
definition: A structural deformity of the hindfoot, the posterior region of the foot formed by the talus and calcaneus.

name: Left-right disorientation
definition: A tendency to mix up left and right in one's own body space, typically elicited by asking a person to perform a two-stage command involving specified lateralized anatomy.
comments: Some suggest that a tendency to mix up left and right of an examiner's body space is a more reliable feature sensitive.

name: Elevated circulating DNAJB9 concentration
definition: The concentration of DNAJB9 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

synonyms.text: DNAJB9 protein level in serum elevated
Elevated DnaJ homolog subfamily B member 9 concentration
Elevated DnaJ homolog subfamily B member 9 level
Elevated DnaJ homolog subfamily B member 9 level in blood
Increased DnaJ homolog subfamily B member 9 concentration
Increased DnaJ homolog subfamily B member 9 level
Increased DnaJ homolog subfamily B member 9 level in blood

comments: DNAJB9 is a proteomic tissue biomarker for fibrillary glomerulonephritis.

name: Olecranon fracture
definition: A partial or complete break in the olecranon,which is the proximal articular portion of the ulna and makes up part of the elbow.
comments: The olecranon is the proximal articular portion of the ulna. Along with the coronoid process, it forms the greater sigmoid (semilunar) notch which articulates with the humerus to provide flexion and extension of the elbow.

name: History of mastectomy
definition: Past medical history of surgical breast removal.

name: Lymphangiosarcoma
definition: A malignant neoplasm arising from the endothelial cells of the lymphatic vessels.

name: Exposure to inhaled lipids
definition: Aspiration or inhalation of lipid-containing products.
comments: Exogenous lipoid pneumonia is caused by aspiration or inhalation of lipid-containing products. In the past, the most common agents included mineral oil-based laxatives and nasal decongestants. Other causes include inhalation of petroleum jelly used as a lubricant, e.g., tracheostomy care. The incidence of exogenous lipoid pneumonia is growing exponentially in all age groups secondary to the phenomenon termed vaping. In the latter case, consider the term Electronic cigarette exposure histor (HP:0430032).

name: Holster sign
definition: Symmetric poikiloderma of hips and lateral thighs below the greater trochanter.
comments: The Holster sign may indicate dermatomyositis.

name: Salivary basal cell adenoma
definition: A rare neoplasm consisting of a monomorphic population of basaloid epithelial cells, and it accounts for approximately 1-2% of all salivary gland tumors.
comments: Thee most frequent location of basal cell adenoma (BCA) of the salivary gland is the parotid gland. It usually appears as a firm and mobile slow-growing mass. Histologically, isomorphic cells in nests and interlaced trabecules with a prominent basal membrane are observed. In contrast to pleomorphic adenoma, it tends to be multiple and its recurrence rate after surgical excision is high.

name: Hemidiaphragm elevation
definition: Elevated Hemidiaphragm is a condition where one portion of the diaphragm is higher than the other. Elevated hemidiaphragm occurs when one side of the diaphragm becomes weak from muscular disease or loss of innervation due to phrenic nerve injury.

name: Cerebriform connective tissue nevus
definition: The cerebriform connective tissue nevus (CCTN) is one of the most characteristic skin findings. It commonly occurs on the soles of the feet, and frequently causes problems because of pain, pruritus, infection, bleeding,exudation, odor, and walking impairment.
comments: The cerebriform connective tissue nevus is frequently observed in patients with Proteus syndrome and it is an important specific criterion for diagnosis.

name: Linear Hyperpigmentation along Blaschko's lines
definition: Linear streaks and swirls of macular hyperpigmentation along the lines of Blaschko.
comments: Blaschko's lines are attributed to the migration lines of epidermal cells during embryogenesis and are characterized by a V-shaped pattern on the posterior midline, S-shape on the abdomen, and spiral on the posterior scalp.

name: Guilt
definition: The experience of remorse, self-reproach, or perceived culpability for a real or perceived unfavorable outcome. Guilt may be proportionate to the context or disproportionate, and it may occur in the absence of an identifiable act, event, or offense. It reflects the interplay of cognitive processes, such as judgments about responsibility, and emotional responses, which can lead to persistent rumination or preoccupation. Guilt may extend to situations outside the individual's control and, in some cases, be accompanied by inaccurate or exaggerated beliefs about one's role in an outcome.
comments: The individuals frequently feel they have violated their own, or universal, moral standards. Guilt often reflects a relationship between disordered thinking or cognitive processes (such as cognitive distortions) and emotional dysregulation resulting in persistent ruminations or preoccupations of remorse and shame. In severe cases, guilt may be associated with delusional beliefs, as seen in psychotic depression.

name: Mediastinal shift
definition: A deviation of the mediastinum from its normal position in the midline of the thoracic cavity. The mediastinum is a compartment of the thoracic cavity that contains the heart and its blood vessels, the esophagus, trachea, thymus, as well as nerves and lymph nodes.
comments: Since the pleural cavity is confined by the rib cage, large pleural effusion may push the structures in the thoracic cavity to the opposite side resulting in a shift of the upper and lower mediastinum. Other etiologies are also observed. See Figures 1 and 2 of PMID:35990927 or Figure 1 of PMID:37680422.

name: Bendopnea
definition: Dyspnea as a result of bending forward while not holding one's breath; dyspnea or shortness of breath onset within 30 seconds of bending forward.
comments: Bendopnea is mediated by increased ventricular filling pressure during bending, which exacerbates an already high filling pressure in patients with heart failure.

name: Pain worse when lying flat
definition: Refers to pain that is worse when the affected individual lies down (flat).

name: Tympanic membrane hypermobility
definition: Abnormally increased ability to move of the tympanic membrane.
comments: In Stickler syndrome, hypermobility is sometimes associated with thin, visibly hyperflaccid tympanic membranes, which is a common and otoscopically detectable sequela of chronic or recurrent otitis media and/or previous tympanostomy tubes. Hypermobility may also be found with normal appearance tympanic membranes.

name: Elevated circulating vitamin B12 concentration
definition: Concentration of vitamin B12 in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
comments: Elevated levels of serum cobalamin may be a sign of a serious, even life-threatening, disease. Hematologic disorders like chronic myelogeneous leukemia, promyelocytic leukemia, polycythemia vera and also the hypereosinophilic syndrome can result in elevated levels of cobalamin.

name: Elevated circulating sFASL concentration
definition: The concentration of sFASL (soluble FASL, soluble FAS-ligand) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
comments: The first apoptosis signal receptor (FAS) pathway regulates apoptosis and is critical for proper development and functioning of the immune system. FAS ligand (FASL) can bind to FAS receptors.

name: Internal anal sphincter achalasia
definition: A disorder of the internal anal sphincter (IAS) in which the IAS fails to relax that manifests clinically as intractable constipation.
comments: The internal anal sphincter, which is a specialized smooth muscle continuation of the circular muscle layer of rectum, plays a significant role in the maintenance of anorectal continence and in the pathophysiology of incontinence and constipation. Internal anal sphincter achalasia is a clinical condition with presentation similar to Hirschsprung disease but with the presence of ganglion cells on suction rectal biopsy.

name: Anthracycline exposure
definition: History of treatment with an anthracycline chemotherapy agent.

name: Binge drinking
definition: A pattern of episodic heavy alcohol use characterized by the consumption of a high number of drinks per occasion.
comments: The World Health Organization defines binge drinking (BD) based on a cut-off of six drinks (i.e., 60g of alcohol) or more per occasion. The National Institute on Alcoholism and Alcohol Abuse (NIAAA) defines BD as a pattern of drinking that brings blood alcohol concentration (BAC) levels to 0.08 g/dL, which typically occurs after 4 drinks (i.e., 56 g of alcohol) for women and 5 drinks (i.e., 70 g of alcohol) for men in about 2 hours.

name: Decreased circulating thrombopoietin concentration
definition: Concentration of thrombopoietin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. Thrombopoietin is a glycoprotein hormone produced by the liver and kidney that stimulates the production and differentiation of megakaryocytes.

name: Collagenoma
definition: A rare hamartomatous malformation characterized by the predominant proliferation of normal collagen fibers and normal, decreased, or increased elastic fibers. Collagenomas may be solitary or multiple, sporadic, acquired or inherited.

name: Lack of sufficient daily physical activity
definition: Physical activity levels less than those required for optimal health and prevention of premature death.

name: Synesthesia
definition: A phenomenon whereby stimulation of one sensory or cognitive pathway leads to automatic, involuntary experiences in a second sensory or cognitive pathway. For instance, people with synaesthesia may experience unusual colors, tastes, and other sensations when engaged in everyday activities like reading or listening to music.

name: Dark cerumen
definition: Abnormally dark color of cerumen (earwax), which is a waxy substance secreted in the ear canal that normally has a brown, orange, red, yellowish or gray.

name: History of spicy food intake
definition: A history of high intake of spciy foods with ingrediaents such as capsaicin, pepper, chili, ginger, garlic, onion, fenugreek, and turmeric.

name: Oil-drop brown pigmentation of the corneal limbus
definition: Brown pigment spots in the limbus (border between the cornea and the sclera).

name: Hazardous alcohol use
definition: Hazardous drinking is defined as a quantity or pattern of alcohol consumption that places individuals at risk for adverse health events. This could include alcohol use despite potentially hazardous or risky consequences, such as operating heavy machinery or drunk driving.

name: Social anxiety
definition: Excessive fear of embarrassment, humiliation, or rejection when exposed to possible negative evaluation by others when engaged in a public performance or social interaction.

name: Placidity
definition: Flat affect and reduced response to emotional stimuli. Fear and anger responses that are normally present are blunted.

name: Phaeohyphomycosis
definition: Phaeohyphomycosis refers to infections due to a large group of heterogenous organisms called dematiaceous or melanized fungi. These fungi are distinguished by the predominance of melanin in their cell walls, which likely acts as a virulence factor. Virtually, everyone is exposed to dematiaceous fungi through inhalation, as they are ubiquitous in the environment, although the development of infection is extremely uncommon.
comments: Invasive disease is rare but remains important due to the ability to cause serious disease in immunocompetent and immunocompromised hosts, unlike other fungal infections such as aspergillosis.

name: Autophony
definition: Hearing one's own voice resonating loudly in the ear.

name: High altitude exposure
definition: A history of being at high altitude in situations such hiking, mountain climbing, travel to mountains, or air travel.

name: History of recent hospitalization
definition: A past medical history of recently being hospitalized.
comments: This may imply a nosocomial infection risk.

name: Palpitations terminated by Valsava maneuver
definition: Cessation of palpitations can be induced by Valsava maneuver.
comments: In patients who can terminate their palpitations with a Valsalva maneuver, this is thought to indicate possibly a supraventricular tachycardia.

name: Long telomere length
definition: Abnormally long telomeres in somatic cells.

name: Reduced circulating aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase activity
definition: The activity of aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase (also known as DOPA decarboxylase, tryptophan decarboxylase, and 5-hydroxytryptophan decarboxylase) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Subclavian artery stenosis
definition: Abnormal narrowing of the subclavian artery.

name: Pulsatile liver
definition: Cardiac synchronous pulsation on palpation.
comments: A pulsating liver is characteristic of significant tricuspid regurgitation. Systolic pulsations of the liver in patients with primary severe tricuspid regurgitation are due to transmission of a prominent right atrial v wave.

name: Neuropathic pain
definition: Neuropathic pain is triggered by lesions to the somatosensory nervous system that alter its structure and function so that pain occurs spontaneously and responses to noxious and innocuous stimuli are pathologically amplified.
comments: Neuropathic pain can be characterized by pain that is triggered when clothes touch the skin, spontaneous burning that feels like boiling water, bursts of pins and needles(paresthesias) in the feet upon walking , a continuous crushing pain after an amputation as if your phantom foot is being squeezed, or a band of searing pain around the body at the level at whichsensation was lost after a spinal cord injury.

name: Repeated cold water exposure
definition: A history of repeated exposure to cold water, as may result, for instance, from surfing, diving, kayaking, or swimming.

name: Tinnitus exacerbated by swallowing
definition: Tinnitus (sound heard by a subjhect when no corresponding external sound is present) that is made worse by swallowing.
comments: During swallowing, the tensor veli palatini (TVP) muscle is activated to assist in elevating the palate. Due to this dual innervation by CNV, the tensor tympani (TT) muscle can be activated and possibly cause tinnitus in some patients.

name: Rhythmic movements of the tympanic membrane
definition: Regularly occurring motion of the tympanic membrane (eardrum), which is located between the inner and middle ear. This can be a manifestation of tensor tympani myoclonus, which can also be ascertained as sawtooth patterns on long-term tympanometry.

name: Elongated temporal styloid process
definition: The length of the temporal styloid process is above the upper limit of normal. The styloid process is a cylindrical, slender, needle-like projection of varying lengths averaging 2 to 3 cm. The styloid process projects from the inferior part of the petrous temporal bone and offers attachment to the stylohyoid ligament and the stylohyoid, stylopharyngeus, and styloglossus muscles.

name: Ameliorated by nitroglycerin
definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with nitroglycerin.

name: Pulsus paradoxus
definition: Pulsus paradoxus refers to a systolic pressure drop greater than 10mmHg during inspiration.
comments: Pulsus paradoxus results from alterations in the mechanical forces imposed on the chambers of the heart and pulmonary vasculature and is often due to pericardial disease, particularly cardiac tamponade and to a lesser degree constrictive pericarditis.

name: Chest pain triggered by palpation
definition: Chest pain can be induced by palpation of the chest, which may be an indication of costochondritis.

name: Chest pain described as pressure
definition: Discomfort in the chest described as pressure, heaviness, or tightness.

name: Chest pain described as ripping or tearing
definition: Chest pain described as a tearing or ripping sensation.
comments: The pain of aortic dissection may be described as tearing or ripping and does not improve with nitroglycerin.

name: Ameliorated by flexion
definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by bending (flexing) a joint.

name: Located on the chest
definition: Applies to a finding that is situated or occurring around the thorax (chest).

name: Localized to the penis
definition: Applies to a finding that is situated or occurring in or on the penis.

name: Snowstorm pattern of uterus on ultrasound
definition: A sonographic snowstorm pattern of the uterus that results from the presence of a complex vesicular intrauterine mass containing many grape-like cysts.
comments: The snowstorm sign is the classic appearance of a complete hydatiform mole. The sign results from multiple hydropic villi and has the ultrasonographic appearance of a central heterogeneous mass with a solid, hyperechoic area together with numerous cystic areas and filling the entire uterine cavity.

name: Multiparity
definition: History of multiple previous births.

name: Exposure to aquatic animals
definition: History of exposure to aquatic animals.
comments: Mycobacterium marinum is an opportunistic pathogen inducing infection in fresh and marine water fish. Human infections with Mycobacterium marinum have been associated with the exposure of damaged skin to polluted water from fish pools or contacting objects contaminated with infected fish. Fish mycobacteriosis is clinically manifested and characterized in man by purple painless nodules, liable to develop into superficial crusting ulceration with scar formation.

name: Superficial blush-like subcutaneous fatty lesions
definition: Multiple, oblong, fatty lesions in the superficial subcutaneous fatty tissue. They are mostly under 2 cm in long axis diameter. They demonstrate nodular (blush-like) increased fluid signal at unenhanced MRI and are markedly hyperechoic at ultrasound.
comments: These lesions are characteristicv of Adiposis dolorosa (Dercum's disease).

name: Dermal multinucleated giant cells
definition: Presence of giant cells in the dermis. Giant cells are formed by fusion of various cells such as macrophage, epithelioid cells, monocytes, etc., These are multi-nucleated, large in size, and generally present at the site of chronic inflammation and other granulomatous conditions.

name: Exacerbation of eyelid lesion by crying
definition: Applies to an eyelid lesion such as hemangiomas or varices that swells upon crying.

name: Localized to upper eyelid
definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the upper eyelid.

name: Aerophagia
definition: Repetitive air swallowing and belching and that may result in abdominal distention.

name: Vaginal passage of hydatidiform mole tissue
definition: Passage from the vagina of hyatidiform tissue, appearing as clusters of vesicles (similar to small grapes) developed from the transformation of chorionic villi. This is a manifestation of a molar pregnancy (hyatidiform mole).

synonyms.text: Solid tissue passed by the vagina

name: Abnormal nipple discharge
definition: Abnormal fluid that seeps out of the nipple of the breast. Nipple discharge is categozied as lactational, physiologic, or pathologic.

name: Hepatolithiasis
definition: The presence of gallstones within the intrahepatic bile ducts proximal to the right and left hepatic ducts.
comments: Hepatolithiasis is benign in nature, but the prognosis is poor due to an association with recurrent cholangitis, biliary strictures, liver abscesses, and atrophy or cirrhosis of the affected liver. Hepatolithiasis is also a known risk factor for intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.

name: Excessive eructation
definition: Abnormally frequent belching (expelling gas noisily from the stomach through the mouth).

name: Esophageal fibrosis
definition: Fibrosis located in the subepithelial portion of the esophagus. Fibrosisis is defined by the overgrowth, hardening, and/or scarring of various tissues and is attributed to excess deposition of extracellular matrix components including collagen.

name: Triggered by extension of leg
definition: This term refers to pain that is triggered by extending (straightening) the leg.
comments: This feature may suggest spinal problems such as spinal epidural abscess.

name: Increased myocardial pyrophosphate uptake
definition: Amount of pyrophosphate uptake by the myocardium as demonstrated by by technetium pyrophosphate (99mTc-PYP) scintigraphy above the upper limit of normal.

name: Ameliorated by nerve block
definition: Refers to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by anesthetic block of a nerve.

name: Brief tear break-up time
definition: Tear film break up time (number of seconds that elapse between the last blink and the appearance of the first dry spot in the tear film) below the lower limit of normal.

name: Cutaneous granuloma
definition: A granuloma localized to the skin, that is, a chronic inflammatory manifestation with localized aggregation of histiocytes with or without other inflammatory cells (such as plasma cells, eosinophils, or neutrophils), with or without necrosis, with or without vasculitis, with or without calcification, and with or without foreign bodies. Granulomas may be due to infection or chronic inflammatory disease or reactions to foreign material.

name: Heterotopic dermal ossification
definition: Formation of abnormal, extraskeletal bony tissue in the dermis (i.e., the layer of skin that lies beneath the epidermis and above the subcutaneous layer).

name: Thinning of outer muscular layer of small bowel
definition: The depth of the outer muscular layer of the small bowel is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Renal lymphangiectasia
definition: A developmental anomaly of renal lymphatics that results from a failure of the lymphatics to make communication with the rest of the lymph trunks. The abnormal lymphatics thus dilate and form cystic spaces at the renal sinus and in the perinephric space.

name: Pharyngeal myxoma
definition: A myxoma (benign, locally infiltrative neoplasms arising from mesenchymal origin) localized to the pharynx.

name: Subcutaneous arteriolar thrombosis
definition: Fibrin thrombi inside subcutaneous arterioles.

name: Renal vasculitis
definition: Vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessels) in the kidney. Renal vasculitis can be observed with numerous disorders and presents clinically as rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis (RPGN) which is characterized by acute kidney injury (AKI), haematuria and proteinuria. Histological examination of the kidney reveals severe inflammation in the form of crescent formation, glomerular necrosis and vasculitis of small and medium sized vessels within the kidney.

name: Pancreatic islet beta cell iron deposition
definition: Accumulation of abnormally high amounts of iron in beta cells of the pancreas.

name: Nasal hamartoma
definition: A hamartoma (tissue malformation consisting of an abnormal mixture of constitutive components) originating in the nose.

name: Metachromatic intraneuronal lipid deposits
definition: A type of metachromasia localized to a peripheral nerve. Metachromasia may be defined as the staining of tissue or tissue components such that the color of the tissue-bound dye complex differs significantly from the color of the original dye complex to give a marked contrast in color. For instance in metachromatic leukodystrophy, bloated Schwann cells, containing granularmetachromatic storage material May display a characteristic yellow green dichroism under crossed polarised light.
comments: In metachromatic leukodystrophy, galactosyl sulfatide (cerebroside sulfate) accumulates in the white matter of the CNS and in the peripheral nerves. Galactosyl sulfatide, and to a lesser extent lactosyl sulfatide, also accumulate within the kidney, gallbladder, and certain other visceral organs and are excreted in excessive amounts in the urine. In histologic preparations, they form spherical granular masses that stain metachromatically (i.e., with a color different from that of the dye solution). See Figure 2 of PMID:16291896.

name: Reduced phosphoserine phosphatase activity in cultured fibroblasts
definition: Activity of phosphoserine phosphatase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

name: Reduced alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts
definition: Activity of alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

synonyms.text: Alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase low in fibroblasts

name: Reduced hepatic beta-ureidopropionase activity
definition: Activity of beta-ureidopropionase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

name: Reduced hepatic dihydropyrimidinase activity
definition: Activity of dihydropyrimidinase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

name: Sunken fontanelle
definition: Fontanelle that is more deeply set than normal. Fontanelles are normally relatively firm and curve only slightly inward. A sunken fontanelle can be a sign of dehydration or marasmus.

name: Angulation of penis
definition: Formation of an angle (tilt) along the shaft of the penis.
comments: This finding can be observed with penis fracture and Peyronie Disease. The latter is caused by a plaque (scar tissue) that pulls on the surrounding tissues and causes the penis to curve or bend, usually during an erection.

name: History of urethral procedure or catheterization
definition: A past medical history of a procedure or catheterization involving the urethra.

name: Penile swelling
definition: Abormal enlargement of the penis owing to accumulation of fluid.

name: Reduced muscle alpha-1,4-glucosidase activity
definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-1,4-glucosidase activity in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Brown tumor
definition: A brown tumor is a bone lesion that results from bony resorption by excess osteoclastic activity, and replacement by fibrous tissue and giant cells. Brown tumor is an uncommon pathognomonic sign of hyperparathyroidism.

name: Dermal flame figures
definition: Flame-figures are composed of a central part consisting of collagen fibers and eosinophilic granules, surrounded by a histiocytic and eosinophilic infiltrate. Subsequently, eosinophils tend to disappear and are replaced by phagocytic granulomas, consisting of histiocytes and sometimes giant cells, around the flame figures.
comments: Flame figures may be observed in Wells syndrome.

name: Postpartum exacerbation
definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is present during pregnancy and becomes worse following birth.

name: Retinoid exposure
definition: History of having taken retinoids.

name: Propylthiouracil exposure
definition: History of having been treated with propylthiouracil.

name: History of outdoor activities
definition: History of spending a substantial amount of time outdoors with occupation or hobbies related to the outdoors, including hunting, gardening, farming, agriculture, horticulture, miners, working in wet fields.

name: Draining sinus tract in skin
definition: A sinus tract is an abnormal channel that originates from the skin or a mucous surface to a deep-seated focus of suppuration.

synonyms.text: Tract under skin draining associated abscess

comments: A soft tissue ulcer can show a sinus tract leading to a deeper soft tissue abscess and may occasionally extend to a joint. Chronic osteomyelitis can be associated with a sinus tract and cloaca (opening or rupture of bony cortex overlying an area of osteomyelitis) draining granulation tissue, pus, or necrotic debris from the bone to the skin.

name: Corneal transplant history
definition: Past medical history of surgical replacement of the cornea with corneal tissue from a donor.

name: Spontaneous lens capsule rupture
definition: Breakage of the capsule of the lens. This is most often observed as a complication of lens surgery, but this term refers to lens capsule rupture not related to surgery or major trauma.
comments: Spontaneous lens capsule rupture has been observed with Marshall syndrome.

name: Contact lens wearer
definition: A past medical history of wearing contact lenses.

name: Airway mucosal thickening
definition: Increase in thickness of the mucosa of the airways above the upper limit of normal.
comments: This feature can be observed in mucolipidosis type II. Progressive airway thickening can lead to respiratory insufficiency.

name: Hyperpolarized transepithelial nasal potential difference
definition: Increased (more negative) voltage across the nasal epithelium.
comments: The resulting (or basal) potential difference (PD) is negative or polarized (viewed from the epithelial surface) and in normal subjects, it is usually between -15 and -25 mV. The measurement continues by the sequential perfusion of compounds that block inwardly directed sodium transport through inhibition of ENaC (amiloride), followed by augmentation of chloride transport through CFTR. During perfusion of amiloride, the potential difference depolarizes as ENaC transport is reduced, and the PD typically approaches a low polarizing value (typically between 0 and -10 mV).

name: Corneopalpebral synechiae
definition: An adhesion between the conjunctiva of the eyelid and the cornea.

name: Breast intraductal papilloma
definition: Intraductal papilloma is a benign tumor found within breast ducts. The abnormal proliferation of ductal epithelial cells causes growth. A solitary intraductal papilloma is usually found centrally posterior to the nipple affecting the central duct. Multiple intraductal papillomas are located peripherally, found in any breast quadrant affecting the peripheral ducts.

name: Precipitous labor
definition: Precipitous labor is extremely rapid labor and delivery, usually defined as expulsion of the fetus within less than 3 hours of commencement of regular contractions.

name: Twin pregnancy
definition: Maternal history of a pregnancy with two fetuses in the uterus.

name: Vaginal mass
definition: A swelling or enlargement localized to the vagina. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: Costovertebral angle tenderness
definition: Pain that is elicited by palpation of the region inside of the costovertebral angle, which is formed by the 12th rib and the spine.
comments: Costovertebral angle tenderness can be observed with conditions including pyelonephritis and ureteral stones.

name: Cervical motion tenderness
definition: Pain that is elicited by moving the uterine cervix. This finding can be ascertained by pelvic exam. Cervical motion tenderness is a gynecological exam finding that could be indicative of peritoneal infection.

name: Abnormal urethral discharge
definition: Fluid that originates from the urethra that is not urine, pre-ejaculate or semen.

name: Supernumerary finger flexion crease
definition: The presence of an extra digital crease in and individual with normal joint anatomy.

name: Large joint predominance
definition: Refers to a phenotypic abnormality that mainly affect large joints.

name: Monoarticular
definition: Refers to a phenotypic abnormality that affects a single joint.

name: Hockey-stick palmar crease
definition: An abnormality of the upper palmar crease whereby the crease widens and ends between the second and third fingers and is said to resemble a hockey stick.
comments: See figure 5 of PMID:29094891.

name: Elevated urinary succinyladenosine level
definition: The amount of succinyladenosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urinary 5-hydroxymethyluracil level
definition: The amount of 5-hydroxymethyluracil in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Decreased urine creatinine level
definition: The amount of creatinine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: Elevated urinary deoxyuridine level
definition: The amount of deoxyuridine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urinary dihydrouracil level
definition: The amount of dihydrouracil in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urinary dihydrothymine level
definition: The amount of dihydrothymine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: Elevated urinary sulfatide level
